items.abstract_or_text: Dan Selsam is a current OpenAI capabilities researcher. (since 2022) He was my boss for a while. He doesn't have a twitter account but has made this public statement of his views on AI risk and sent it to me to share: Dan Selsam's Personal Statement on AI Risk: I have been working on AI for over fifteen years, across many different paradigms. I did early work on probabilistic programming languages at MIT, was one of the early developers of the Lean Theorem Prover at Microsoft Research, demonstrated one of the first instances of neural networks learning to reason for my PhD at Stanford, and since joining OpenAI almost five years ago, have helped pioneer chain-of-thought optimization on language models and, more recently, data-efficient pretraining methods. Like many others, I have become extremely concerned about how far language models have come and the risks that future iterations will pose. I am encouraged by the recent proposals by the leaders of the frontier research efforts to require third-party oversight, and to push for domestic and international coordination to address risks. However, I believe a major consideration has been absent from the public conversation, and that merely pacing the frontier more carefully will not adequately limit the long-term risk. The crucial and overlooked problem is that the models are becoming so situationally aware that we are losing the ability to evaluate them in contexts where they believe they are not being watched or controlled.
items.summary_zh: 事实：Daniel Kokotajlo 转发了一份署名 Dan Selsam 的 AI 风险个人声明。声明作者认为，单靠放缓前沿研发不足以限制长期风险，并把模型在自认未受监控情境下的可评估性视为被忽略的问题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：这是来自前沿研究从业者、且带有明确论点的风险讨论；帖文是他人代转，所述经历与判断应视为声明作者观点，而非独立验证结论。
items.abstract_zh: Dan Selsam 是现任 OpenAI 能力研究员（自 2022 年起）。他曾有一段时间是我的上司。他没有 X 账号，但已发布这份关于 AI 风险的公开声明，并发给我代为分享： Dan Selsam 关于 AI 风险的个人声明：我从事 AI 已超过十五年，横跨多种范式。我早期在 MIT 做概率编程语言；在微软研究院参与了 Lean 定理证明器的早期开发；读博期间在斯坦福展示了神经网络学习推理的早期实例之一；近五年加入 OpenAI 后，协助开创语言模型的思维链优化，最近还参与数据高效预训练方法。和许多人一样，我越来越担心语言模型已达到的能力及其未来版本带来的风险。我受到前沿研究负责人的近期提案鼓舞：要求第三方监督，并推进国内与国际协调来应对风险。然而，我认为公共讨论忽略了一个重要考量，仅仅更谨慎地放慢前沿进程，无法充分限制长期风险。关键且被忽视的问题是：模型的情境意识正变得如此强，以至于我们正在失去在它们相信自己未被监视或控制的情境中评估它们的能力。

items.abstract_or_text: ⚛️🇪🇺 Introducing Quasar 1.1 438B, the first AI model using quantum-generated data. Quasar 438B, the best European AI model, just got a quantum upgrade: Part of its healing set was generated by a hybrid quantum language model running on @IBM Quantum System Two in Donostia-San Sebastián, a 156-qubit IBM Heron processor. It is the first time quantum-generated data enters the CompactifAI pipeline. Quantum computing is not a label on this release, it is part of how the model was built. Sharper, less verbose, tuned for agentic work and ready for European deployment: served by a European company incorporated under EU law and developed in line with EU regulatory requirements, including the transparency expectations of the EU AI Act.

items.abstract_or_text: I read @DarioAmodei's essay calling on the labs to pace the frontier. @sama agreed. The frontier will move at whatever speed it moves. The rest of the world will not slow down. Our job in the cybersecurity community is to make sure it moves securely and safely. Here’s what I see from the front lines: 1. The unit of threat is no longer the hacker. It's an autonomous campaign. I call it the Agent-state. We see coordinated AI agents executing attack campaigns at machine speed. 2. Sophistication is dead as an attribution signal. AI gives every criminal and lone actor elite execution. Identity, infrastructure, and intent tell you who's behind an attack. Skill doesn't. 3. Runtime is the control point. Endpoints, cloud workloads, and SaaS are the battleground. Governance documents don't stop an agent in motion. Enforcement at machine speed does. 4. Every AI agent is a privileged identity. Least privilege, short-lived credentials, traceable actions, and a kill switch. Permissions never expand because an agent decides it needs more. 5. Defense has to be autonomous but also bounded. Machine-speed response, tiered by consequence, with humans owning the high-impact calls. 6. Every failed attack should make every defender smarter. Feed what we block back into detection, across customers and models, with privacy intact. This is what CrowdStrike and NVIDIA introduced with SafeMind: an agentic, always improving model and harness protection system built for defenders. 7. The AI industrial base is critical infrastructure: weights, training clusters, APIs. Call it what it is and protect it like it is. Pacing what comes next doesn't secure what's already here. The credible path is to deploy with proof: board-level accountability for AI security, independent external red teaming, incident disclosure, secure defaults, and controls that work in production - not on paper. Anthropic and OpenAI just committed to embedding independent evaluators with employee-level access. CrowdStrike will bring what we see from the front lines to that table. The ability for AI to act must be matched by the ability for defensive AI to stop the breach.
items.summary_zh: 事实：CrowdStrike 联合创始人兼 CEO George Kurtz 围绕前沿模型研发节奏发文，主张安全重点应放在运行时执行控制、最小权限、短期凭证、可追溯操作、终止机制及分级的人类决策上，并提及 CrowdStrike 与 NVIDIA 的 SafeMind。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：帖文给出了面向已部署智能体的具体安全控制框架，能推动从原则性治理转向生产环境控制面的讨论；对攻击态势和产品效果的描述属于作者及其公司立场。
items.abstract_zh: 我读了 Dario Amodei 呼吁实验室放慢前沿步伐的文章。Sam Altman 也同意。前沿会以它本来的速度推进，世界其他地方不会慢下来。网络安全界的工作是确保它安全、可靠地推进。以下是我从一线看到的： 1. 威胁的单位不再是黑客，而是自主行动的攻击活动。我称之为“Agent-state”。我们看到协调的 AI 智能体以机器速度执行攻击活动。 2. 复杂程度不再是归因信号。AI 让每个犯罪者和独立行动者都拥有精英级执行能力。身份、基础设施和意图告诉你谁在背后，而不是技能。 3. 运行时是控制点。终端、云工作负载和 SaaS 是战场。治理文件不能阻止一个正在行动的智能体，必须以机器速度执行控制。 4. 每个 AI 智能体都是特权身份。应实行最小权限、短期凭证、可追溯行动和终止开关；权限不能因为智能体认为自己需要而扩大。 5. 防御必须自主，但也必须受限。以机器速度响应，并按后果分级，由人类承担高影响决策。 6. 每次失败的攻击都应让每位防御者更聪明。把拦截到的内容反馈给跨客户、跨模型的检测系统，同时保护隐私。这正是 CrowdStrike 和 NVIDIA 推出的 SafeMind 所做的：一个为防御者构建的、具有智能体特征且持续改进的模型与执行框架保护系统。 7. AI 工业基础设施是关键基础设施：权重、训练集群、API。应如实看待并按其重要性保护。 放慢未来的速度并不能保护已经存在的东西。可信的路径是带着证据部署：董事会层面的 AI 安全问责、独立的外部红队测试、事件披露、安全默认设置，以及在生产环境中而非纸面上有效的控制。Anthropic 和 OpenAI 刚刚承诺让独立评估者获得等同员工的访问权限。CrowdStrike 将把我们从一线看到的情况带到这张桌上。AI 的行动能力必须与防御性 AI 阻止入侵的能力相匹配。

items.title: From Computational Chemistry to Generative Models: A Survey of AI-Driven Small-Molecule Drug Discovery
items.abstract_or_text: Small-molecule drug discovery requires navigating enormous chemical space to identify candidates that are simultaneously potent, selective, synthetically accessible, and acceptable across pharmacokinetic and safety profiles; modern generative AI extends a long computational medicinal chemistry lineage that began with QSAR, pharmacophore modeling, and early structure-based de novo design. This survey focuses primarily on developments from 2017 to 2025, with the literature updated through 31 January 2026. Using a medicinal-chemistry lens, it first establishes the shared machinery of the field: molecular representations such as SMILES, SELFIES, graphs, fingerprints, three-dimensional coordinates, voxels, and latent vectors; commonly used datasets and benchmarks; and graph neural network encoders, including message-passing, directional, and equivariant architectures. We compare five principal generative mechanisms—autoregressive models, variational autoencoders, generative adversarial networks, normalizing flows, and diffusion models—together with reinforcement learning as a major goal-directed optimization framework. Across these approaches, we show that current methods offer complementary rather than interchangeable trade-offs, and we highlight recurring challenges, including validity versus synthesizability, limited prospective experimental validation, mode collapse and diversity loss, stereochemical and physical realism in three-dimensional design, computational cost, data scarcity, and the emerging convergence toward scaffold-conditioned generation, hybrid architectures, developability-aware optimization, and molecular foundation models.
items.summary_zh: 这篇综述以药物化学视角梳理2017–2025年、更新至2026年1月的 AI 小分子药物发现：分子表示、数据集、图网络、五类生成机制及强化学习，并系统讨论可合成性、立体化学、三维物理真实性与前瞻验证短板。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它为生成式药物设计的方法选择与证据边界提供近期、结构化的全景图，尤其明确指出前瞻实验验证不足；作为综述不提供独立新实验或模型验证，具体主张仍需回到原始研究核查。
items.abstract_zh: 小分子药物发现需要在巨大的化学空间中寻找同时具备效力、选择性、可合成性，并在药代动力学和安全性特征方面可接受的候选物；现代生成式 AI 延续了始于 QSAR、药效团建模和早期基于结构的从头设计的长期计算药物化学传统。这篇综述主要聚焦2017至2025年的发展，文献更新至2026年1月31日。它首先以药物化学视角建立该领域的共同基础：SMILES、SELFIES、图、指纹、三维坐标、体素和潜在向量等分子表示；常用数据集和基准；以及包括消息传递、方向性和等变架构在内的图神经网络编码器。我们比较了五种主要生成机制——自回归模型、变分自编码器、生成对抗网络、归一化流和扩散模型——以及作为主要目标导向优化框架的强化学习。跨这些方法，我们表明当前方法提供的是互补而非可互换的权衡，并强调反复出现的挑战，包括有效性与可合成性之间的矛盾、有限的前瞻性实验验证、模式坍塌和多样性损失、三维设计中的立体化学和物理真实性、计算成本、数据稀缺，以及向骨架条件生成、混合架构、可开发性认知优化和分子基础模型的新兴汇聚。

items.title: Countering Neural Activity Drift: Sustained Long-term Seizure Prediction Using an Evolutionary Machine-Learning Framework on Continuous Intracranial EEG
items.abstract_or_text: Objective: Seizure prediction in drug-resistant epilepsy remains a major biomedical challenge. Traditional machine learning approaches rely heavily on segmented offline testing, which suffers from artificial class rebalancing, hides neural activity drift over time, and severely inflates performance estimates. This study introduces an online evolutionary framework designed for realistic brain-computer interface validation and addresses performance degradation caused by neural drift. Methods: We present the first publicly available, continuous long-term stereoelectroencephalography dataset for seizure prediction, tracking 16 patients across 664.9 hours of data and 121 seizures. An offline combinatorial analysis evaluated pipeline decisions (referencing, frequency bands, functional connectivity metrics, and classifiers). The highest-performing offline elements, namely monopolar referencing, cross-correlation-based connectivity matrices, and Random Forests classifiers, were evaluated under realistic class imbalances in a pseudo-prospective online framework. Candidate models (N = 1,000 per patient) were evolved across continuous streams, while a data-driven approach targeted patient-specific epileptogenic networks for input channel reduction. Results: Transitioning from offline to online evaluation demonstrated a prominent performance drop, with mean AUROC degrading from 90% to 57.9%, confirming offline metrics conceal temporal neural drift. However, our online evolutionary framework identified models achieving complete event-level seizure prediction in 75% of patients (and all but one seizure in 87.5%). Restricting inputs to the estimated epileptogenic network identified using our previously proposed approach reduced implanted contact requirements by 79.12% while providing superior predictive performance over clinically resected areas. Significance: This work demonstrates that actionable, deterministic seizure prediction is achievable when paired with modern computational capability. Because 1,000 candidate models represent a conservative proof-of-concept search budget, scaling search spaces in production environments can further expand optimal interictal sampling and prediction yields. By providing both a continuous benchmark dataset and a standardized online evaluation protocol, this framework offers a foundation for self-adapting closed-loop devices capable of post-event retraining and long-term deployment in clinical neuromodulatory.
items.summary_zh: 该研究公开连续长期立体脑电图数据集，覆盖 16 名患者、664.9 小时数据和 121 次发作，并以伪前瞻在线评估量化神经活动漂移对癫痫预测的影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 连续流和真实类别不平衡设置揭示离线评估会高估性能，也为闭环神经调控的长期验证提供数据与协议；证据仍来自小样本预印本，不能等同于临床部署效果。
items.abstract_zh: 目的：药物难治性癫痫的发作预测仍是一项重大生物医学挑战。传统机器学习方法严重依赖分段式离线测试，这种测试存在人为类别再平衡、掩盖随时间变化的神经活动漂移，并严重夸大性能估计的问题。本研究提出一种为真实脑机接口验证而设计的在线进化框架，并解决由神经漂移导致的性能下降。方法：我们提出首个公开可用的、用于发作预测的连续长期立体脑电图数据集，追踪 16 名患者的 664.9 小时数据和 121 次发作。离线组合分析评估了流程决策，包括参考方式、频段、功能连接指标和分类器。在现实类别不平衡条件下，使用伪前瞻在线框架评估性能最高的离线要素，即单极参考、基于互相关的连接矩阵和随机森林分类器。候选模型（每名患者 N = 1,000）在连续数据流中进化；同时，数据驱动方法针对患者特异性致痫网络进行输入通道缩减。结果：从离线评估转换为在线评估后，平均 AUROC 从 90% 降至 57.9%，显示离线指标掩盖了时间性神经漂移。然而，在线进化框架在 75% 的患者中识别出实现全部事件级发作预测的模型，并在 87.5% 的患者中预测到除一次外的所有发作。将输入限制为使用我们此前提出的方法估计的致痫网络后，植入接触点需求减少 79.12%，且预测性能优于临床切除区域。意义：本工作表明，当与现代计算能力结合时，可操作、确定性的发作预测是可实现的。由于 1,000 个候选模型代表保守的概念验证搜索预算，在生产环境中扩大搜索空间可进一步扩展最佳发作间期采样和预测收益。通过提供连续基准数据集和标准化在线评估协议，该框架为能够在事件后再训练并长期部署于临床神经调控中的自适应闭环装置奠定基础。

items.title: Proving olympiad geometry theorems on a superconducting quantum processor
items.abstract_or_text: Automated theorem proving seeks to use computational systems to prove or disprove mathematical and logical statements [1, 2]. It underpins a wide range of applications, and enhancing theorem-proving capabilities remains a central objective in artificial intelligence [3]. Although recent neuro-symbolic systems have achieved remarkable progress [4-7], their operation is ultimately constrained by classical computational architectures. Quantum computing [8], by contrast, enables information encoding and coherent parallelism beyond classical limits [9-14], raising the possibility of accelerating structured symbolic deduction [15]. Here we report the experimental realization of automated geometry theorem proving on a fully programmable superconducting quantum processor. We develop two complementary quantum proving frameworks. The first implements Wu's algebraic elimination method using quantum pseudo-division, with multivariate polynomials represented in superposition states, enabling quantum algebraic theorem proving. The second implements the full-angle method as backward symbolic reasoning through a hybrid quantum strategy-guided architecture, demonstrating a general route toward quantum symbolic proof search. As illustrative examples, we prove two theorems on a superconducting quantum processor: the perpendicularity of the diagonals of a square and a 1978 International Mathematical Olympiad geometry problem. Our results establish, at the experimental level, automated logical reasoning as a viable task for near-term quantum processors and provide a concrete pathway toward quantum-enhanced symbolic intelligence.
items.summary_zh: 该研究在可编程超导量子处理器上演示两种几何定理证明框架，并报告证明正方形对角线垂直及一道 1978 年 IMO 几何题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作提供了明确的硬件实验对象、两种符号推理路线和两个示例定理；其证据支持概念验证，不应外推为量子处理器已普遍加速自动定理证明。
items.abstract_zh: 自动定理证明旨在使用计算系统证明或证伪数学与逻辑陈述 [1, 2]。它支撑广泛的应用，提升定理证明能力仍是人工智能的核心目标 [3]。尽管近期神经符号系统已取得显著进展 [4-7]，其运行最终仍受经典计算架构约束。相比之下，量子计算 [8] 允许超越经典极限的信息编码和相干并行性 [9-14]，因而带来加速结构化符号演绎的可能性 [15]。在此，我们报告了在一台完全可编程超导量子处理器上实现自动几何定理证明的实验。我们开发了两种互补的量子证明框架。第一种使用量子伪除法实现 Wu 的代数消元方法，其中多元多项式以叠加态表示，从而实现量子代数定理证明。第二种将全角法实现为通过混合量子策略引导架构进行的反向符号推理，展示了一条通向量子符号证明搜索的通用途径。作为示例，我们在一台超导量子处理器上证明了两个定理：正方形两条对角线的垂直性，以及一道 1978 年 International Mathematical Olympiad 几何题。我们的结果在实验层面确立了自动逻辑推理作为近期量子处理器可行任务的地位，并为量子增强的符号智能提供了一条具体路径。

items.title: Concerted, Facile CO2 Hydrogenation in Ni-MOF-74 Revealed by Machine Learning Interatomic Potential-Based Enhanced Sampling Simulations
items.abstract_or_text: Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) with open metal sites are promising heterogeneous catalysts, but the atomistic and dynamic details that govern their reactivity are difficult to access experimentally due to spatiotemporal resolution limits. Computational studies, predominantly gas-phase density functional theory (DFT) calculations, have been used to study MOF-catalysed reactions, but typically rely on reduced cluster models of the metal center that neglect confinement effects or treat the framework as rigid during the reaction, limiting realistic modeling of catalysis at finite temperature and pressure. Here, we investigate, as a prototypical reaction, CO2 hydrogenation inside Ni-MOF-74 using machine learning interatomic potentials-based molecular dynamics and on-the-fly probability-based enhanced sampling (OPES) simulations, which delineate dynamic adsorption of CO2 and H2 in a flexible MOF and provide the underlying free energy for the CO2 reduction reaction. OPES simulations further reveal that H2 first adsorbs and undergoes heterolytic dissociation at the Ni-O site with a free energy barrier of ∼16 kcal mol−1, forming a proton and hydride species. Subsequent reduction of CO2 to HCOOH proceeds via a concerted mechanism, involving simultaneous hydride and proton transfer through a single transition state with a relatively low activation barrier of ∼6 kcal mol−1. These results demonstrate that explicit treatment of framework flexibility and thermodynamic conditions is essential to accurately capture reaction mechanisms and energetics in porous catalysts. Our integrated MLIP-OPES approach provides a generalizable computational framework for studying complex chemical transformations under confinement in MOFs and related framework materials.
items.summary_zh: 工作将 MLIP 分子动力学与 OPES 增强采样用于柔性 Ni-MOF-74 中 CO2 加氢，提出 H2 在 Ni–O 位点异裂后经协同氢化物/质子转移生成 HCOOH 的自由能路径。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究将框架柔性、限域和有限温压条件纳入 MOF 催化机理计算，较静态簇模型更接近真实反应环境；不过结论主要来自模拟，仍需要原位实验或独立高精度计算交叉验证。
items.abstract_zh: 具有开放金属位点的金属有机框架（MOF）是很有前景的多相催化剂，但由于时空分辨率限制，控制其反应性的原子尺度和动态细节难以通过实验获得。计算研究主要采用气相密度泛函理论（DFT）计算来研究 MOF 催化反应，但通常依赖金属中心的简化簇模型，忽略限域效应，或在反应中将框架视为刚性，从而限制了对有限温度和压力下催化的真实建模。本文以原型反应为例，利用基于机器学习原子间势（MLIP）的分子动力学和即时概率增强采样（OPES）模拟，研究 Ni-MOF-74 内的 CO2 加氢；这些方法描绘了柔性 MOF 中 CO2 和 H2 的动态吸附，并给出了 CO2 还原反应的自由能。OPES 模拟进一步揭示，H2 首先吸附并在 Ni–O 位点发生异裂，其自由能垒约为16 kcal mol−1，形成质子和氢化物物种。随后 CO2 经由协同机制还原为 HCOOH，其中氢化物和质子通过单一过渡态同时转移，活化能垒相对较低，约为6 kcal mol−1。这些结果表明，显式处理框架柔性和热力学条件对于准确捕捉多孔催化剂中的反应机制和能量学至关重要。我们整合的 MLIP-OPES 方法为研究 MOF 及相关框架材料中限域条件下复杂化学转化提供了可推广的计算框架。

items.title: Evaluating large language models as clinical decision support tools in primary healthcare settings: Protocol for a multi-country comparative validation study on expert-adjudicated hypothetical vignettes (hypMOOVE-PHC)
items.abstract_or_text: Introduction: Large language models (LLMs) have the potential to strengthen clinical decision-making in low-resource primary healthcare (PHC) settings. However, most LLMs are developed and benchmarked in high-resource settings and evidence on their safety and contextual appropriateness in Sub-Saharan Africa remains limited. The hypMOOVE-PHC study is the hypothetical vignette phase of the Massive Open Online Validation and Evaluation (MOOVE) initiative, implemented in Kenya, Malawi, and Tanzania. It aims to validate a pool of LLMs through clinical review of expert-generated vignettes. Methods and analysis: This is a fully crossed repeated-measures comparative evaluation study. In each country, experienced clinicians develop 200-250 hypothetical clinical vignettes reflecting realistic patient presentations and independently produce a human benchmark care plan for each. Vignettes are used to prompt a selection of six open-source and proprietary LLMs selected based on code availability, local hostability, and model size. During in-person workshops (valiDATAthons), independent clinical experts rate LLM- and human-generated responses in source-attribution masked side-by-side comparisons across five dimensions (clinical soundness, safety, contextual fit, clarity & completeness, and appropriate confidence). The primary endpoints are each LLM's overall performance profile and non-inferior safety profile, as compared to the human benchmark. At minimum, 358 evaluations per LLM (or 1,253 paired evaluations in total) are required per country. Ethics and dissemination: The study is approved by the EPFL Human Ethics Research Committee in Switzerland, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health in the USA, KNH-UoN Ethics and Research Committee in Kenya, MUBAS Research Ethics Committee in Malawi, and MUHAS Research and Ethics Committee and National Institute for Medical Research in Tanzania. Findings will be reported according to the TRIPOD-LLM framework and shared with national ministries of health, disseminated at conferences and in peer-reviewed journals, and de-identified benchmark data will be released under FAIR principles.

items.abstract_zh: 引言：大语言模型（LLMs）有望加强资源有限的初级医疗（PHC）场景中的临床决策。然而，大多数 LLM 在高资源环境中开发和基准测试，关于其在撒哈拉以南非洲的安全性和情境适宜性的证据仍有限。hypMOOVE-PHC 研究是 Massive Open Online Validation and Evaluation（MOOVE）倡议的假设病例情景阶段，在肯尼亚、马拉维和坦桑尼亚实施。它旨在通过对专家生成病例情景的临床审查，验证一组 LLM。方法与分析：这是一项完全交叉、重复测量的比较评估研究。在每个国家，经验丰富的临床医生将开发 200–250 个反映真实患者表现的假设临床病例情景，并独立为每个情景制定人工基准照护计划。病例情景用于提示基于代码可用性、本地主机部署能力和模型规模选定的六个开源和专有 LLM。在面对面工作坊（valiDATAthons）期间，独立临床专家在来源归属被遮蔽的并排比较中，从五个维度对 LLM 和人工生成的回答评分：临床合理性、安全性、情境适配性、清晰度与完整性，以及恰当的置信度。主要终点是每个 LLM 的总体性能图谱以及相对于人工基准的非劣安全性图谱。每个国家每个 LLM 至少需要 358 次评估（或总计 1,253 次配对评估）。伦理与传播：本研究已获瑞士 EPFL Human Ethics Research Committee、美国 Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health、肯尼亚 KNH-UoN Ethics and Research Committee、马拉维 MUBAS Research Ethics Committee、坦桑尼亚 MUHAS Research and Ethics Committee 及 National Institute for Medical Research 批准。研究结果将按 TRIPOD-LLM 框架报告，并与各国卫生部共享，在会议和同行评议期刊上传播；去标识化基准数据将依 FAIR 原则发布。

items.title: Hydrogen diffusion on metals: Full-Dimensional Ring Polymer Molecular Dynamics Rate Calculations
items.abstract_or_text: The diffusion of hydrogen atoms on nine different metals: Co, Ni, Cu, Rh, Pd, Ag, Ir, Pt, Au, has been simulated by ring polymer molecular dynamics. For Co, the (0001) surface facet has been chosen, while for all other metals, (100) surfaces are investigated. For the nine systems, message-passing atomic cluster expansion (MACE) machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) were set up by means of self-consistent biased fine-tunings. The H diffusion was sampled first with the MACE MP-0 foundation model by means of umbrella samplings along the diffusion path; then, a subset of sampled structures was recalculated by periodic density-functional theory (DFT) and the MACE was fine-tuned with the obtained reference data. This was repeated once to correct for biases of the foundation model concerning the sampling of configuration space. Thorough benchmarking revealed that the fine-tuned MLIPs were reliable and of high quality, also for situations not covered by the training set. The fine-tuned MACE MLIPs were then used to sample the full-dimensional diffusion rate constants with the Caracal program for temperatures between 20 and 300 K, in 10 K steps, and from them obtain the temperature-dependent diffusion coefficients. Crossover temperatures to the deep tunneling regime were calculated as well.
items.summary_zh: 研究以自洽偏置微调的 MACE MLIP 配合环聚合物分子动力学，计算 H 在九种金属表面20–300 K的全维扩散速率、扩散系数及深隧穿交叉温度。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作将基础 MLIP、周期 DFT 回算和核量子动力学联用，可系统研究金属表面氢扩散与量子隧穿，对催化和储氢相关表面过程具有基础价值；可靠性主要依据计算基准，仍需与实验动力学直接比对。
items.abstract_zh: 使用环聚合物分子动力学模拟了氢原子在九种不同金属 Co、Ni、Cu、Rh、Pd、Ag、Ir、Pt、Au 上的扩散。对于 Co，选择（0001）表面晶面；对于其他所有金属，研究（100）表面。针对这九个体系，通过自洽偏置微调建立了 message-passing atomic cluster expansion（MACE）机器学习原子间势（MLIP）。首先，利用 MACE MP-0 基础模型，沿扩散路径通过伞形采样对 H 扩散进行采样；随后，对一部分采样结构用周期性密度泛函理论（DFT）重新计算，并利用得到的参考数据微调 MACE。该过程重复一次，以校正基础模型在构型空间采样方面的偏差。深入的基准测试表明，微调后的 MLIP 是可靠且高质量的，对训练集未覆盖的情形亦然。随后，使用微调后的 MACE MLIP，通过 Caracal 程序在20至300 K温度范围内、每10 K一步，对全维扩散速率常数进行采样，并由此获得温度依赖的扩散系数。还计算了进入深隧穿区的交叉温度。

items.title: OpenAI4S: Code as Action, Science as Sessions
items.abstract_or_text: AI co-scientists could accelerate computational research, but over a long-running study the workflow also has to stay inspectable, resumable and reproducible, which requires persistent computational state and provenance. Here we present OpenAI4S, an open-source scientific research agent built around the principle of Code as Action, Science as Sessions. OpenAI4S combines a persistent computing runtime with research-session management: orchestration is handled through structured tool calls, while scientific actions are represented as complete code cells executed in persistent Python and R kernels. An append-only Action Ledger, per-cell execution records, versioned artifacts, environment records, and workspace checkpoints preserve how results were produced and support session recovery, branching, and extension. Configurable sandboxing, permission controls, and code and trajectory screening provide complementary safeguards. We evaluate OpenAI4S on 36 research scenarios spanning retrosynthesis, molecular dynamics, protein binder design, protein mutation, catalyst screening, and mineral spectroscopy, measuring scientific task accuracy, workflow completeness, and reproducibility of the resulting repositories. OpenAI4S achieves an overall score of 7.83, compared with 5.7--6.4 for a general-purpose coding harness evaluated with three frontier models, with the largest gains on long-horizon and computation-intensive workflows. These results suggest that integrating persistent execution with session-level provenance can improve the reliability of AI-assisted scientific workflows. Environment specification and full rerunnability remain weak for every evaluated system, ours included, so reproducibility is still an open problem for scientific agents. The system is available under the MIT license at https://github.com/PKU-YuanGroup/OpenAI4S{github.com/PKU-YuanGroup/OpenAI4S}.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI4S 以持久计算内核、会话管理、追加式操作账本和版本化产物构建开源科学研究智能体，并在逆合成、分子动力学、蛋白结合体设计、催化剂筛选等36个场景中评估准确性、工作流完整性和可复现性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作面向长程化学计算的状态保存、溯源和恢复问题，且覆盖多个 AI for Science 任务；其总体评分来自作者设定的36个场景，且作者承认所有系统的环境规格与完全可重跑性仍较弱。
items.abstract_zh: AI 协同科学家可能加速计算研究，但在一项长期运行的研究中，工作流还必须保持可检查、可恢复和可复现，这要求持久的计算状态和来源追踪。本文提出 OpenAI4S，这是一个围绕“Code as Action, Science as Sessions”原则构建的开源科学研究智能体。OpenAI4S 将持久计算运行时与研究会话管理结合：编排通过结构化工具调用处理，而科学操作表示为在持久 Python 和 R 内核中执行的完整代码单元。追加式 Action Ledger、每个单元的执行记录、版本化产物、环境记录和工作区检查点保存结果如何产生，并支持会话恢复、分叉和扩展。可配置沙箱、权限控制以及代码和轨迹筛查提供补充性保障。我们在36个研究场景上评估 OpenAI4S，这些场景涵盖逆合成、分子动力学、蛋白结合体设计、蛋白突变、催化剂筛选和矿物光谱；测量科学任务准确度、工作流完整性以及所得仓库的可复现性。OpenAI4S 的总体得分为7.83，而以三个前沿模型评估的通用编码框架得分为5.7--6.4，在长时程和计算密集型工作流上的增益最大。这些结果表明，将持久执行与会话级来源追踪整合，可提高 AI 辅助科学工作流的可靠性。包括我们自己的系统在内，每个受评系统的环境规范和完全可重跑性仍然较弱，因此可复现性仍是一个开放问题。该系统以 MIT 许可证提供，网址为 https://github.com/PKU-YuanGroup/OpenAI4S{github.com/PKU-YuanGroup/OpenAI4S}。

items.title: Potential of Artificial Intelligence Algorithms for Identification of Relevant Diagnostic and Prognostic Biomarkers of Early-Stage Liver Cancer
items.abstract_or_text: This study explores the use of deep learning and explainable artificial intelligence to diagnose hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and define effective biomarkers across five different stages of disease development using a transcriptomic biomarker HCC dataset constructed via semi-supervised learning from three source datasets. Several deep learning experiments were conducted with different feature extraction techniques and gene sets to identify the most effective features for training high-accuracy models with minimal loss. The best-performing model, using 15 selected genes with the SelectKBest algorithm, achieved 90.74% accuracy, while the model with the lowest recorded loss of 0.3187 was obtained using 20 selected genes. To address the issue of class imbalance in the dataset, a weighted training approach was conducted, and for model transparency and interpretability a SHAP-based XAI analysis provided insights into the model's decision-making, consistently finding DNAJB14 as the most influential gene. Functional validation in this study has provided compelling evidence that DNAJB14 plays an important role in the adverse properties of HCC and that its inhibition effectively reverses tumour cell migration, invasion, colony and sphere formation. The main limitation of this study is the dataset's class imbalance, and while weighted training helped mitigate this, further research and additional data are needed to guarantee model generalizability. Future studies should also explore the influence of genetic variations, environmental factors, and clinical differences on model performance across diverse populations.
items.summary_zh: 研究以三个来源数据集经半监督学习构建的 HCC 转录组标志物数据集训练深度学习模型；15 基因 SelectKBest 模型准确率为 90.74%，并以 SHAP 和功能实验将 DNAJB14 列为重点候选。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将转录组预测、可解释性分析与细胞功能验证连接起来；但数据类别不平衡，且尚需更大、更多样化的人群验证其泛化性。
items.abstract_zh: 本研究探索使用深度学习和可解释人工智能诊断肝细胞癌（HCC），并在疾病发展的五个不同阶段界定有效生物标志物；所用 HCC 转录组标志物数据集由三个源数据集经半监督学习构建。研究以不同特征提取技术和基因集进行了多项深度学习实验，以识别能以最小损失训练高准确率模型的最有效特征。性能最佳的模型使用 SelectKBest 算法选出的 15 个基因，准确率达到 90.74%；记录到最低损失 0.3187 的模型则使用了 20 个选定基因。为处理数据集类别不平衡问题，研究采用加权训练方法；为提升模型透明度和可解释性，基于 SHAP 的 XAI 分析揭示了模型决策过程，并一致发现 DNAJB14 是影响最大的基因。本研究的功能验证为 DNAJB14 在 HCC 不良特性中发挥重要作用提供了有力证据，且抑制 DNAJB14 可有效逆转肿瘤细胞迁移、侵袭、克隆形成和球体形成。该研究的主要局限性是数据集类别不平衡；尽管加权训练有助于缓解这一问题，仍需要进一步研究和更多数据来保证模型的泛化性。未来研究还应探索遗传变异、环境因素和临床差异对不同人群模型性能的影响。
items.author_line: Ali Bou Nassif, Darko Castven, Manar Abu Talib, Jibran Sualeh Muhammad, Ahmed Ammar Kubba, Jens Marquardt, Abdalla Sayed Ali

items.title: Explainable machine learning-assisted differentiation of brucellosis from tuberculosis via routine blood biomarkers
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background: To enable low-cost differential diagnosis in primary care settings, we developed a machine-learning model integrating routine clinical indicators and occupational exposure history to discriminate between brucellosis and tuberculosis. Key predictive features were identified via feature selection, and a parsimonious model was subsequently constructed. The model's generalizability was rigorously validated through internal cross-validation and external testing to provide an affordable, practical auxiliary tool for resource-limited primary healthcare. Methods: A retrospective cohort of 273 patients from the Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital affiliated with Xinjiang Medical University was enrolled. After 1:1 propensity score matching, 180 patients (90 with brucellosis, 90 with tuberculosis) were included. Thirty-five clinical variables and occupation were recorded. Four models—logistic regression, support vector machine, random forest (RF), and XGBoost—were developed using 10-fold stratified cross-validation. SHAP analysis identified core features. A three-variable simplified RF model was constructed and validated on an independent temporal test set (n = 42). Results: Among the evaluated algorithms, random forest (RF) achieved the best internal cross-validation performance, with an AUC of 0.9056 ±0.0697, whereas XGBoost exhibited greater variability. SHAP analysis identified occupation, alanine aminotransferase (ALT), and γ-glutamyl transferase (GGT) as the most influential predictors. A simplified RF model incorporating only these three variables yielded a cross-validated AUC of 0.834 ±0.1052. Compared with the full‑feature model, the simplified version retained 92.09% of the original AUC and 97.26% of the sensitivity. Although a minor decrease in accuracy was observed, the McNemar test revealed no statistically significant difference between the two models (P = 0.0776) at the α = 0.05 level. Decision curve analysis showed comparable clinical net benefit. In the external test set, the simplified model attained an AUC of 0.8265 (95% CI: 0.696–0.957), with a sensitivity of 85.71% and a specificity of 71.43%. Conclusion: The three-variable simplified random forest model—incorporating occupation, GGT, and ALT—exhibits robust discrimination in distinguishing brucellosis from tuberculosis. It demonstrates reliable generalizability in external validation and represents a simple, cost-effective diagnostic aid for primary care settings.
items.summary_zh: 该回顾性队列在 273 名患者中开发布鲁氏菌病与结核病鉴别模型；三个变量的简化随机森林在独立时间测试集（n = 42）上 AUC 为 0.8265。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 职业、ALT 和 GGT 构成的简化模型面向资源有限的初级医疗场景，并含时间外部测试；样本量有限，尚不能作为独立诊断工具。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景：为在初级医疗场景中实现低成本鉴别诊断，我们开发了一种机器学习模型，整合常规临床指标和职业暴露史以区分布鲁氏菌病与结核病。通过特征选择识别关键预测特征，随后构建简约模型。通过内部交叉验证和外部测试严格验证模型泛化性，以为资源有限的初级医疗提供一种可负担、实用的辅助工具。方法：纳入新疆医科大学附属中医医院的 273 名患者回顾性队列。经 1:1 倾向评分匹配后，纳入 180 名患者（90 名布鲁氏菌病患者、90 名结核病患者）。记录 35 个临床变量和职业。采用 10 折分层交叉验证开发四种模型——逻辑回归、支持向量机、随机森林（RF）和 XGBoost。SHAP 分析识别核心特征。构建三变量简化 RF 模型，并在独立时间测试集（n = 42）中验证。结果：在评估的算法中，随机森林（RF）取得最佳内部交叉验证性能，AUC 为 0.9056 ± 0.0697，而 XGBoost 的变异性更大。SHAP 分析将职业、丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）和 γ-谷氨酰转移酶（GGT）识别为最有影响的预测因子。仅纳入这三个变量的简化 RF 模型取得交叉验证 AUC 0.834 ± 0.1052。与全特征模型相比，简化版保留了原始 AUC 的 92.09% 和敏感性的 97.26%。尽管准确率略有下降，McNemar 检验显示两个模型在 α = 0.05 水平上无统计学显著差异（P = 0.0776）。决策曲线分析显示相当的临床净获益。在外部测试集中，简化模型达到 AUC 0.8265（95% CI：0.696–0.957），敏感性为 85.71%，特异性为 71.43%。结论：纳入职业、GGT 和 ALT 的三变量简化随机森林模型，在区分布鲁氏菌病与结核病方面显示出稳健的区分能力。其在外部验证中显示可靠泛化性，并可作为初级医疗场景中简单、具有成本效益的诊断辅助工具。
items.author_line: Song W, Zhou J, Xu R, Deng J, Ma J, Yasheng Z, Xiang X, Guo L, Liu Y, Ma X

items.title: Stellar Colosseum: A Many-Agent Harness for Long-Horizon Research in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science
items.abstract_or_text: Language models can produce plausible short proofs, but may still be unreliable on long-horizon research problems, where progress depends on a sequence of uncertain and interdependent decisions. We introduce Stellar Colosseum, a model-agnostic harness for allocating inference across research in mathematics and theoretical computer science. Colosseum explores alternative strategies before proof construction, uses a readiness gate to decide when a route is mature enough to decompose, represents the proof plan as interdependent section-level subproblems, and routes verifier findings back to the affected part of the argument. Across these stages, it generates candidates in parallel, attacks them with targeted falsification, and combines candidates and their critiques into a single research artifact through overlapping random-sample tree aggregation. The Colosseum workflow has also been integrated into Google Antigravity's Teamwork framework as the Long Proof pattern. We demonstrate the capabilities of Colosseum through open-ended research and evaluations on theorem-proving and competitive programming benchmarks. Using Colosseum with Gemini 3.1 Pro, we obtain several new results that address open problems arising from papers published at top venues such as FOCS and JMLR. On TCS-Bench, a benchmark of research-level theorem-proving tasks drawn from papers published at FOCS, STOC, and SODA, Colosseum achieves 71.0% accuracy using Gemini 3.1 Pro and Gemini 3.7 Flash. In a separate Codeforces evaluation using Gemini 3.1 Pro, the proof-oriented pipeline with execution feedback solves 218 of 222 problems.
items.summary_zh: Stellar Colosseum 是用于数学与理论计算机科学长程研究的多智能体编排框架，结合策略探索、证明计划分解、反驳和验证反馈回路。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 论文给出了 TCS-Bench 和 Codeforces 上的具体结果，因而可审阅其流程在既定基准中的表现；不能据此将系统的开放研究产出概括为普遍可靠的数学发现能力。
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型可以生成看似合理的短证明，但在长程研究问题上仍可能不可靠；在此类问题中，进展依赖一系列不确定且相互依赖的决策。我们提出 Stellar Colosseum，这是一个与模型无关的框架，用于在数学和理论计算机科学研究中分配推理资源。Colosseum 在构造证明之前探索替代策略，使用就绪门控来判断一条路线何时成熟到可以分解，将证明计划表示为相互依赖的章节级子问题，并将验证器发现反馈到论证中受影响的部分。在这些阶段中，它并行生成候选方案，以针对性证伪加以攻击，并通过重叠的随机样本树聚合，将候选及其批评整合为单一研究产物。Colosseum 工作流也已作为 Long Proof 模式集成到 Google Antigravity 的 Teamwork 框架中。我们通过开放式研究以及定理证明和竞赛编程基准上的评测展示 Colosseum 的能力。将 Colosseum 与 Gemini 3.1 Pro 结合使用时，我们得到若干新结果，处理了源自 FOCS 和 JMLR 等顶级会议发表论文的开放问题。在由 FOCS、STOC 和 SODA 论文中的研究级定理证明任务构成的 TCS-Bench 上，Colosseum 使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 和 Gemini 3.7 Flash 达到 71.0% 准确率。在另一项使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的 Codeforces 评测中，带有执行反馈的面向证明流水线解决了 222 道题中的 218 道。
items.author_line: Honghao Lin, David P. Woodruff, Yuan Deng, Jieming Mao, Song Zuo, Vahab Mirrokni

items.title: AlgoEvo: Self-Evolving Agentic Search for Automated Algorithm Discovery
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models have advanced automated algorithm discovery by synthesizing executable code, but existing frameworks trap them in rigid search pipelines with pre-defined control flows. This limitation restricts adaptive reasoning, blocks cross-paradigm transfer, and discards valuable execution feedback. We propose AlgoEvo, a unified agentic framework that transforms automated algorithm discovery into an interactive, knowledge-accumulating process. An autonomous agent dynamically inspects, diagnoses, and edits code based on runtime feedback. A design skill hub decouples paradigm-specific knowledge from the core discovery engine, allowing a single workflow to seamlessly handle single-objective, multi-objective, and multi-component design. Meanwhile, a hierarchical experience mechanism organizes search trajectories into a task-level tree to guide exploration and consolidates cross-task patterns into reusable skills. Across six representative benchmark tasks, AlgoEvo matches or surpasses specialized methods with substantially fewer evaluations and reduced token consumption, demonstrating strong intra-task accumulation, cross-task transfer, and the ability to reproduce or exceed existing state-of-the-art performance through flexible skill activation.
items.summary_zh: AlgoEvo 将算法发现建模为利用运行时反馈进行代码检查、诊断与编辑的智能体搜索，并以层级经验和技能库跨任务积累设计知识。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 论文在六项基准任务上比较专用方法，考察评估次数、token 消耗与性能；其结果主要支持自动算法搜索流程，而非对生成算法的普遍最优性保证。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型已通过合成可执行代码推进自动算法发现，但现有框架将其困在具有预定义控制流的刚性搜索流水线中。这一限制约束了自适应推理，阻碍跨范式迁移，并丢弃宝贵的执行反馈。我们提出 AlgoEvo，一个统一的智能体框架，将自动算法发现转化为交互式、知识累积的过程。自主智能体根据运行时反馈动态检查、诊断和编辑代码。设计技能中心将特定范式知识从核心发现引擎中解耦，使单一工作流能够无缝处理单目标、多目标和多组件设计。同时，分层经验机制将搜索轨迹组织为任务级树，以引导探索，并将跨任务模式整合为可复用技能。跨六个代表性基准任务，AlgoEvo 以显著更少的评估次数和更低的 token 消耗，达到或超过专用方法，展示了强大的任务内累积、跨任务迁移，以及通过灵活技能激活复现或超过已有最先进性能的能力。
items.author_line: Junhao Qiu, Qinglong Hu, Xialiang Tong, Mingxuan Yuan, Liyong Lin, Qingfu Zhang

items.title: MIRAGE: Measuring Interpolation and Redundancy in Affinity GEneralization
items.abstract_or_text: Deep learning now underpins structure-based drug design, from complex and affinity prediction to ligand ranking and pose generation. Recent co-folding models reportedly approach free-energy-perturbation accuracy at far lower cost. Yet standard evaluation, a single held-out correlation or pooled pose-success rate, cannot separate transferable binding principles from repeated exposure to related protein families in public databases, and practical success depends on genuinely novel targets. We introduce MIRAGE (Measuring Interpolation and Redundancy in Affinity GEneralization), a plug-in benchmark treating historical public family support (through 2019) as an explicit variable, applying a family-support axis to affinity and pose prediction via matched strata, family-disjoint controls, ligand-only baselines, and temporal evaluation. Co-folder affinity accuracy rises sharply with family support, while shallow controls that cannot exploit the test family stay flat, large for co-folders and near zero for every family-disjoint or trivial control. For Nesso-1 it survives covariate, conditioning, balancing, and clustering checks; Boltz-2's endpoint is limited by coverage. It localizes to family support rather than ligand chemistry, approaching a level from family identity alone. Rankings reverse on novel families, where a family-disjoint random forest leads both co-folders, significantly vs Nesso-1. On one external low-support target, neither co-folder beats molecular weight, corroborative rather than population-level evidence. gnina shows significant support dependence in rescoring whereas smina does not; MSA-free pose engines show larger gaps than smina redocking. This redundancy-driven inflation differs from conventional leakage. We propose reporting performance across family support plus excess over a support-insensitive baseline, and release MIRAGE as an installable benchmark and dataset.
items.summary_zh: MIRAGE 提出以蛋白家族历史数据支持度为显式变量的亲和力与构象预测评测框架，显示部分共折叠模型在新蛋白家族上的优势可被家族冗余显著夸大，并发布了相应基准与数据集。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把“测试集独立”进一步拆解为对未见蛋白家族的真实泛化，直接影响结构导向药物设计模型的可信评估；但对外部低支持靶点的证据仅来自一个案例，Boltz-2 的分析也受覆盖范围限制。
items.abstract_zh: 深度学习如今支撑着结构导向药物设计，从复合物和亲和力预测到配体排序与构象生成。近期的共折叠模型据称以远低于自由能微扰的成本达到了接近其的准确度。然而，标准评估——单一留出相关性或汇总的构象成功率——无法区分可迁移的结合原理与对公共数据库中相关蛋白家族的重复暴露，而实际成功取决于真正新颖的靶点。我们提出 MIRAGE（Measuring Interpolation and Redundancy in Affinity GEneralization），这是一个可插拔基准，将历史公共家族支持度（截至2019年）作为显式变量；它通过匹配分层、家族不相交对照、仅配体基线和时间评估，为亲和力和构象预测引入家族支持度轴。共折叠模型的亲和力准确度随家族支持度急剧上升，而不能利用测试家族的浅层对照保持平坦：对于共折叠模型该效应很大，而对每个家族不相交或平凡对照均接近于零。对 Nesso-1 而言，该结果经受住了协变量、条件化、平衡和聚类检查；Boltz-2 的终点受覆盖范围限制。该效应定位于家族支持度而非配体化学，接近仅由家族身份即可达到的水平。在新家族上，排序发生逆转：家族不相交随机森林领先于两种共折叠模型，且相较 Nesso-1 具有显著优势。在一个外部低支持靶点上，两种共折叠模型均未胜过分子量，这只是佐证性而非总体层面的证据。gnina 在重评分中显示出显著的支持度依赖性，而 smina 没有；无 MSA 的构象引擎比 smina 重对接显示出更大的差距。这种由冗余驱动的膨胀不同于传统的数据泄漏。我们建议报告跨家族支持度的性能，以及相对于对支持度不敏感的基线的超额表现，并以可安装的基准和数据集形式发布 MIRAGE。
items.author_line: Mehdi Yazdani-Jahromi, Sanjay Padhi, Ivan Garibay

items.title: El Agente Potente: High-Throughput Agentic Atomistic Simulations
items.abstract_or_text: Foundational machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are transforming atomistic simulations by achieving near-ab initio accuracy across large chemical spaces at a fraction of the computational cost. A central challenge in using these tools for high-throughput property calculations is translating high-level scientific intent into adaptive simulation campaigns without compromising workflow rigour. We introduce El Agente Potente, an agentic system that combines typed execution graphs with a complementary coding mode for MLIPs-driven atomistic simulations. Typed execution graphs provide structured and provenance-aware execution for standardized workflows, with large language models (LLMs) restricted to planning and routing while deterministic Python components perform scientific computation and validation. Complementing this structured execution, a coding agent constructs customized workflows for tasks requiring greater procedural flexibility while invoking existing Potente functions for supported calculations. We demonstrate El Agente Potente across computational materials discovery, molecular energy-landscape exploration, adsorption, and catalytic reaction workflows, together with systematic benchmarks of reproducibility and LLM token cost. These results establish typed execution graphs and code-based workflow construction as complementary mechanisms for agentic scientific computing, combining controlled, auditable execution with the flexibility required for customized atomistic simulations
items.summary_zh: El Agente Potente 将受类型约束、可追溯的执行图与编码智能体模式结合，让 LLM 负责规划和路由、确定性 Python 组件负责计算和验证，并在材料发现、吸附、催化与分子能量景观任务中评估可复现性和 token 成本。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该架构针对科学智能体把灵活性与可审计执行分层，适合 MLIP 高通量模拟；摘要虽称进行了系统基准，但未给出具体科学准确度或独立复现结果，实践效益需进一步验证。
items.abstract_zh: 基础机器学习原子间势（MLIP）正通过以极低的计算成本在大化学空间中达到接近从头算的准确度，改变原子尺度模拟。将高层级科学意图转化为自适应模拟活动，同时不损害工作流严谨性，是在高通量性质计算中使用这些工具的一项核心挑战。我们介绍 El Agente Potente，这是一个用于 MLIP 驱动原子尺度模拟的智能体系统，结合了类型化执行图和互补的编码模式。类型化执行图为标准化工作流提供结构化且具来源追踪能力的执行，其中大型语言模型（LLM）被限制于规划和路由，确定性的 Python 组件执行科学计算和验证。作为对这种结构化执行的补充，编码智能体为需要更大程序灵活性的任务构建定制工作流，同时为受支持的计算调用现有 Potente 函数。我们在计算材料发现、分子能量景观探索、吸附和催化反应工作流中演示 El Agente Potente，并系统评测可复现性和 LLM token 成本。这些结果确立了类型化执行图和基于代码的工作流构建，作为智能体科学计算中互补的机制：它们将受控、可审计的执行与定制化原子尺度模拟所需的灵活性相结合。
items.author_line: Tsz Wai Ko, Jiaru Bai, Thomas Swanick, Yeonghun Kang, Changhyeok Choi, Angelina Qihong Jiang, Aiwei Yin, Varinia Bernales, Alán Aspuru-Guzik

items.title: Agentic-AI-ready genome-wide poxvirus-host interaction screen refined by a protein language model
items.abstract_or_text: Recent mpox outbreaks highlight the necessity to understand the interactions between poxviruses and the human host. These can be discovered systematically through screening for host genes involved in infection at the single-cell level using RNA interference. However, off-target effects and assay noise obscure true gene-phenotype relationships, hampering the discovery of therapeutically relevant targets. Here, we show that integrating protein-protein interaction information derived from a protein language model boosts the discovery of vaccinia virus-host interactions. We propose ICARus - a positive-unlabelled read-out refinement framework to achieve this. Our approach enhances the identification of human genes with potential antiviral function. We provide the raw and refined read-outs of a genome-wide screen for vaccinia virus host factors as an agentic-AI-enabled community resource. Our findings provide a generalisable strategy for robust hit prioritisation in functional screens, accelerating discovery across complex biological systems.
items.summary_zh: ICARus 将蛋白质语言模型导出的蛋白—蛋白相互作用信息整合到全基因组 vaccinia virus 宿主因子 RNA 干扰筛选，并提供原始及经修正的筛选读出。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 面向 mpox 相关痘病毒宿主互作，工作针对功能筛选中的脱靶和噪声问题提出可复用的命中优先级方法；其治疗靶点价值尚待后续独立实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 近期 mpox 暴发表明，有必要理解痘病毒与人类宿主之间的相互作用。可通过 RNA 干扰在单细胞水平筛选参与感染的宿主基因，系统地发现这些相互作用。然而，脱靶效应和测定噪声会掩盖真实的基因—表型关系，阻碍发现具有治疗相关性的靶点。本文显示，整合由蛋白质语言模型导出的蛋白—蛋白相互作用信息，可提升 vaccinia virus—宿主相互作用的发现。我们提出 ICARus——一种正例—未标注读出修正框架——以实现这一目标。该方法增强了对具有潜在抗病毒功能的人类基因的识别。我们将 vaccinia virus 宿主因子的全基因组筛选原始和修正读出作为面向 Agentic AI 的社区资源提供。研究结果提出了一种可泛化策略，用于功能筛选中的稳健命中优先级排序，并加速复杂生物系统中的发现。
items.author_line: Anter J, Mercer J, Yakimovich A

items.title: SAILOR: Solver-Assisted Interactive LLM-based Optimization Recovery
items.abstract_or_text: Natural-language descriptions of optimization problems may be incomplete or vague about numerical information that a solver requires, including costs, capacities, demands, bounds, and penalties. A language model can translate the description into code, but when a required value is absent it must either stop or guess. We present SAILOR, a proof-of-concept system that detects such unsupported numerical choices, asks the user targeted follow-up questions, and updates the optimization model before returning a solution. Questions are prioritized using uncertainty and solver-derived estimates of how strongly each missing value affects the current model. We evaluate the pipeline on 1,723 instances from seven masked benchmarks using an idealized simulator that returns ground-truth values. Exact objective-value agreement ranges from 27.0% to 87.6% across datasets, with 1.4--5.7 questions per instance on average. These results establish feasibility under controlled branch-and-reveal feedback; they do not measure performance with human users or general structural model repair. Code is available at: https://github.com/sshaghayeghs/SAILOR.
items.summary_zh: SAILOR 用求解器信息定位自然语言优化描述中缺失且不受支持的数值假设，向用户提出针对性问题后更新模型并求解。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 1,723 个经掩蔽基准实例以及精确目标值一致性提供了清晰评测；作者明确限定为理想化真值反馈，尚未验证真实用户交互或一般结构修复。
items.abstract_zh: 优化问题的自然语言描述可能不完整，或对求解器所需的数值信息含糊不清，包括成本、容量、需求、边界和惩罚。语言模型可以将描述翻译为代码，但当所需数值缺失时，它必须停止或猜测。我们提出 SAILOR，这是一个概念验证系统，能够检测这类缺乏支持的数值选择，向用户提出有针对性的后续问题，并在返回解之前更新优化模型。问题按不确定性以及从求解器导出的、每个缺失值对当前模型影响程度的估计来排序。我们在来自七个掩蔽基准的 1,723 个实例上，用返回真值的理想化模拟器评估该流水线。各数据集上的精确目标值一致性范围为 27.0% 至 87.6%，每个实例平均提出 1.4 至 5.7 个问题。这些结果在受控的分支—揭示反馈下确立了可行性；它们不衡量与人类用户交互时的性能，也不衡量一般结构模型修复。代码见：https://github.com/sshaghayeghs/SAILOR。
items.author_line: Shaghayegh Sadeghi, Stephen L. Smith, David C. Del Rey Fern'andez

items.title: Can Autonomous LLM Agents Execute Multireference Quantum Chemistry Calculations?
items.abstract_or_text: Multireference electronic-structure calculations remain difficult to automate because critical workflow decisions, including active-space selection, state averaging, convergence recovery, and state identification, traditionally rely on expert judgment. Here, we investigate whether an autonomous large language model (LLM) agent can perform these tasks without human intervention. The agent selects active spaces using literature-grounded analogies or explicitly documented chemical reasoning, generates and submits ORCA calculations, analyzes outputs, and records all decisions in an auditable reasoning log. Benchmarking against 558 vertical transition energies (VTEs) from QUESTDB shows that an unguided baseline agent achieves 24.9% coverage with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.373 eV. Introducing a structured decision ladder increases coverage to 44.1% while reducing the MAE to 0.339 eV. The largest gains are observed for double and Rydberg excitations, demonstrating that expert-informed procedural guidance substantially improves active-space construction and state identification. When provided with complete workflow information, the agent successfully reproduces published QUEST calculations with an MAE of only 23 meV, resolving 75% of target configurations within seven attempts. These results demonstrate that contemporary LLM agents can autonomously execute and reproduce complex multireference quantum-chemical workflows, while highlighting the importance of structured reasoning frameworks for achieving reliable high-throughput and high-fidelity electronic-structure calculations.
items.summary_zh: 研究评估自主 LLM 智能体能否完成多参考量子化学工作流，并以结构化决策阶梯改善活性空间选择、收敛恢复与态识别，在 QUESTDB 垂直跃迁能上提高覆盖率并降低误差。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 多参考计算是高难度电子结构任务；该工作将可审计决策记录与定量基准结合，为高通量自动化提供了可检验路径。局限是无引导基线覆盖率仍低，较强复现表现依赖提供完整工作流信息。
items.abstract_zh: 多参考电子结构计算仍难以自动化，因为活性空间选择、态平均、收敛恢复和态识别等关键工作流决策传统上依赖专家判断。本文研究一个自主大型语言模型（LLM）智能体能否在无人干预下完成这些任务。该智能体使用基于文献的类比或明确记录的化学推理选择活性空间，生成并提交 ORCA 计算，分析输出，并在可审计的推理日志中记录全部决策。以 QUESTDB 的558个垂直跃迁能（VTE）为基准，无引导基线智能体达到24.9%的覆盖率，平均绝对误差（MAE）为0.373 eV。引入结构化决策阶梯后，覆盖率提高至44.1%，MAE 降至0.339 eV。对双激发和 Rydberg 激发观察到最大增益，表明由专家知识启发的程序性指导可显著改进活性空间构建和态识别。当获得完整工作流信息时，该智能体成功复现已发表的 QUEST 计算，MAE 仅为23 meV，并在七次尝试内解决75%的目标构型。这些结果表明，当代 LLM 智能体能够自主执行和复现复杂的多参考量子化学工作流，同时凸显结构化推理框架对于实现可靠、高通量和高保真电子结构计算的重要性。
items.author_line: Victor Chang Lee, James M. Rondinelli

items.title: Symmetry- and Property-Aware Crystal Generation with Reinforcement Learning for Inverse Materials Design
items.abstract_or_text: The inverse design of crystalline materials ultimately seeks structures with desired physical properties. However, for many functional responses, a favorable numerical value is meaningful only when supported by the symmetry of the underlying crystal. Without the appropriate crystallographic constraints, an apparent response may be ill defined, accidental, or not symmetry protected. Here we introduce SPARC, a symmetry- and property-aware reinforcement learning framework that optimizes physical objectives while preserving the structural conditions required for their realization. We demonstrate SPARC on two complementary tasks. The first targets strong uniaxial dielectric anisotropy, a tensorial response that is well defined only within appropriate crystal classes. The second maximizes the spectroscopic limited maximum efficiency, a scalar device-level objective without a prescribed symmetry class, allowing the framework to identify favorable crystallographic motifs. These results show that symmetry is not merely an additional design constraint, but a physical foundation for generating candidates with meaningful, robust, and realizable functional properties.
items.summary_zh: SPARC 以强化学习同时优化晶体物性目标和实现该物性的对称性条件，并在单轴介电各向异性与光谱限制最大效率两项逆向设计任务中展示了该约束框架。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把空间群对称性从附加筛选条件提升为生成阶段的物理约束，有助于减少“数值好看但物理不可实现”的材料候选；摘要未给出实验合成或稳定性验证，候选可行性仍待后续评估。
items.abstract_zh: 晶体材料的逆向设计最终寻求具有目标物理性质的结构。然而，对于许多功能响应，只有当其得到底层晶体对称性的支持时，一个有利的数值才有意义。没有恰当的晶体学约束，表观响应可能定义不清、偶然出现，或不受对称性保护。本文提出 SPARC，这是一个具有对称性和性质感知能力的强化学习框架，在保持实现物理目标所需结构条件的同时优化物理目标。我们在两项互补任务中演示 SPARC。第一项针对强单轴介电各向异性，这是一种仅在适当晶体类别中才有良好定义的张量响应。第二项最大化光谱限制最大效率，这是一个没有预设对称性类别的标量器件级目标，使该框架能够识别有利的晶体学基序。这些结果表明，对称性不只是额外的设计约束，更是生成具有有意义、稳健且可实现功能性质的候选物的物理基础。
items.author_line: Ting-Wei Hsu, Arun Bansil, Qimin Yan

items.title: TimeThink: Eliciting Compositional Reasoning in Timeseries Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Timeseries multimodal large language models (TS-MLLMs) have recently begun leveraging the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) for question-answering tasks. However, these models often fail to capture dynamic temporal patterns, providing only implicit reasoning that lacks the underlying explanations critical for high-stakes applications like healthcare. While reinforcement learning (RL)-based timeseries language models aim to address this, they often fall short because they are trained on narrow, in-distribution data and struggle with out-of-distribution compositional questions. To address these challenges, we present TimeThink, a synthetic framework for eliciting compositional timeseries reasoning. Core timeseries primitives (e.g., trend, seasonality) are domain-independent and can be deterministically generated. Guided by this premise, TimeThink first designs a synthetic data generator that produces atomic and composite question-answer pairs, providing objective ground truth with reasoning traces. Building on this framework, TimeThink employs a reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) training strategy that encourages explicit reasoning. Unlike template-reliant methods, this approach enables the model to learn the underlying logic of composition rather than simply imitating traces. Extensive experiments show that TimeThink, trained only on synthetic data, significantly outperforms strong baselines on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks.
items.summary_zh: TimeThink 从可确定生成的趋势、季节性等时间序列原语构造带推理轨迹的原子与组合问题，并以 RLVR 训练显式组合推理。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 合成生成器可提供客观真值和推理轨迹，且论文同时报告真实基准测试；这使组合时间序列推理可被分解评估，但不等同于高风险时间序列应用中的可靠解释。
items.abstract_zh: 时间序列多模态大语言模型（TS-MLLMs）近来开始利用大语言模型（LLMs）的推理能力完成问答任务。然而，这些模型常常无法捕捉动态时间模式，只提供缺乏底层解释的隐式推理；而这种解释对于医疗等高风险应用至关重要。尽管基于强化学习（RL）的时间序列语言模型旨在解决这一问题，但它们常因在狭窄的、分布内数据上训练而不足，并且难以处理分布外组合问题。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 TimeThink，这是一个用于引出组合性时间序列推理的合成框架。核心时间序列原语（例如趋势、季节性）与领域无关，并可确定性生成。基于这一前提，TimeThink 首先设计一个合成数据生成器，产生原子和组合的问答对，并提供具有推理轨迹的客观真值。在此框架上，TimeThink 采用具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）训练策略，鼓励显式推理。与依赖模板的方法不同，该方法使模型能够学习组合的底层逻辑，而非仅模仿轨迹。大量实验表明，仅使用合成数据训练的 TimeThink，在合成和真实世界基准上均显著优于强基线。
items.author_line: Sudarshan Regmi, Arvind Pillai, Yu Yvonne Wu, Yuliang Chen, Bibek Panthi, Tess Z. Griffin, Michael V. Heinz, Lisa Marsch, Nicholas C. Jacobson, Andrew Campbell

items.title: Can LLMs Normalize Databases? A Benchmark and Multi-Agent Framework for Schema Normalization
items.abstract_or_text: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate structured outputs, but their reliability remains unclear when those outputs must satisfy database-level constraints. We study this issue through database normalization, involving reasoning about functional dependencies, lossless join decompositions, and inter-table constraints. We introduce a Database Normalization Benchmark (DNBENCH), comprising 3,275 samples for evaluating LLM-driven database normalization from 1NF to BCNF. DNBENCH uses a three-axis protocol to measure semantic equivalence, structural accuracy, and logical validity. Across Single, Complex, and Real World levels, DNBENCH uncovers recurring failures in dependency inference, schema decomposition, and inter-table constraint reconstruction. We further propose Multi-Agent Reasoning for Schemas (MARS), which separates evidence extraction, violation diagnosis, and decomposition planning from schema generation and verification. MARS improves the DNB-SCORE by 82.0% over the single-prompt baseline. All artifacts will be released upon acceptance.
items.summary_zh: DNBENCH 用 3,275 个样本评估从 1NF 到 BCNF 的数据库规范化，并以语义等价、结构准确和逻辑有效性三轴检查输出；MARS 将证据、诊断、规划与生成验证分工。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 数据库规范化包含函数依赖与无损分解等可形式化约束，三轴协议使模型输出不只按文本相似度评分；全部制品尚待接收后发布，复现条件仍有限。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）日益用于生成结构化输出，但当这些输出必须满足数据库层面的约束时，其可靠性仍不清楚。我们通过数据库规范化研究此问题，其中涉及对函数依赖、无损连接分解和表间约束的推理。我们提出 Database Normalization Benchmark（DNBENCH），其中包含 3,275 个样本，用于评估由 LLM 驱动的、从 1NF 到 BCNF 的数据库规范化。DNBENCH 使用三轴协议测量语义等价性、结构准确性和逻辑有效性。跨越 Single、Complex 和 Real World 层级，DNBENCH 揭示了依赖推断、模式分解和表间约束重构中反复出现的失败。我们还提出 Multi-Agent Reasoning for Schemas（MARS），它将证据提取、违例诊断和分解规划，与模式生成和验证分离。MARS 相比单提示基线将 DNB-SCORE 提升 82.0%。所有制品将在接收后发布。
items.author_line: Dong-Jae Koh, Huisu Kim, SeongHwan Yoon, Lasse M. Jantsch, Chun-Hee Lee, Seonghyeon Lee, Young-Kyoon Suh

items.title: CausalArena: Benchmarking Causal Discovery in the Foundation Model Era
items.abstract_or_text: Causal discovery aims to uncover causal structures from data and is fundamental to scientific reasoning and intervention-based decision making. Its evaluation relies heavily on structural causal models (SCMs), which specify a causal graph together with the mechanisms that generate data, yet existing studies differ substantially in graph families, mechanisms, and evaluation protocols. The emergence of causal discovery foundation models (CDFMs) further complicates evaluation: performance may reflect not only causal discovery ability, but also overlap between pretraining environments and test SCMs, making results on fixed synthetic benchmarks difficult to interpret. We introduce CausalArena, a unified and evolvable benchmark for causal discovery under a common protocol. Synthetic SCMs supply controlled breadth over structures and mechanisms; semantic operational SCMs provide human-auditable, semantically grounded environments beyond standard synthetic generators; and formula-grounded SCMs test discovery under explicit scientific mechanisms. Public real-world datasets provide an additional external-validity check. Experiments across classical, neural, and pretrained methods reveal substantial ranking shifts across SCM families and protocols, showing that strong performance in one benchmark regime does not reliably transfer to others. These results highlight benchmark diversity and pretraining--evaluation overlap as central challenges for evaluating causal discovery in the foundation model era.
items.summary_zh: CausalArena 为因果发现建立统一且可扩展的评测协议，结合合成 SCM、语义操作 SCM、公式驱动 SCM 与公开真实数据，以考察不同评测族之间的排序变化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 因果结构识别可在明确的结构因果模型下测量。该基准特别检验预训练环境与测试环境重叠造成的解释风险，避免将单一合成基准排名直接当作通用因果发现能力。
items.abstract_zh: 因果发现旨在从数据中揭示因果结构，是科学推理和基于干预决策的基础。其评估高度依赖结构因果模型（SCMs）；SCM 同时指定因果图和生成数据的机制，但现有研究在图族、机制和评估协议上差异很大。因果发现基础模型（CDFMs）的出现进一步复杂化了评估：性能可能不仅反映因果发现能力，也反映预训练环境与测试 SCM 的重叠，使固定合成基准上的结果难以解释。我们提出 CausalArena，这是一个在共同协议下评测因果发现的统一且可演进基准。合成 SCM 在结构和机制上提供受控的广度；语义操作 SCM 提供超出标准合成生成器、可由人审计且具语义落地的环境；公式驱动 SCM 则在明确科学机制下测试发现。公开真实世界数据集提供额外的外部有效性检查。对经典、神经和预训练方法的实验揭示，不同 SCM 族和协议之间存在显著的排名变化，表明在一种基准体制中的强性能并不能可靠地迁移到其他体制。这些结果凸显了基准多样性以及预训练—评测重叠，是基础模型时代评估因果发现的核心挑战。
items.author_line: Zi-Rong Li, Si-Yang Liu, Tian-Zuo Wang, Han-Jia Ye

items.abstract_or_text: But there is a 1 hour talk, with results and evidence, that leads to these conclusions. Also, I am not saying that LLM-based AI tools are useless. They are very useful. We all use them. But, by themselves, they are not a path to human-level AI. Architectures that understand the real world are not LLMs. The architectural components that enable current LLM-based AI systems to interpret images, videos, and other real-world signals are not LLMs.
items.summary_zh: 事实：Yann LeCun 表示，基于 LLM 的工具很有用，但单独并不是通向人类水平 AI 的路径；他认为理解现实世界的架构及当前系统处理图像、视频等信号的关键组件并非 LLM。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：这是一位长期研究者对系统架构边界的明确立场，适合保留为专业讨论材料；帖文所称一小时演讲中的“结果和证据”未随候选内容提供，不能据此替其论断作证。
items.abstract_zh: 但有一场一小时的演讲，其中的结果和证据导向这些结论。而且，我并不是说基于 LLM 的 AI 工具没有用；它们非常有用，我们都在使用它们。但仅靠它们本身，并不是通向人类水平 AI 的路径。能够理解现实世界的架构不是 LLM。让当前基于 LLM 的 AI 系统能够解释图像、视频和其他现实世界信号的架构组件，也不是 LLM。
items.author_line: Yann LeCun

items.abstract_or_text: What does it mean to pace the frontier? Over the last month, @random_walker and I have analyzed the loss-of-control incidents at AI companies to understand what technical and policy interventions can improve safety and what companies should do to pace the frontier. The result is a new 13,000 word essay — our most substantial writing on AI safety since AI as Normal Technology.
items.summary_zh: 事实：Sayash Kapoor 称自己与合作者在过去一个月分析了 AI 公司发生的失控事件，并发布一篇约 13,000 字文章，讨论可提升安全性的技术与政策干预，以及公司应如何放缓前沿研发。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：该帖明确给出了分析对象、问题和成文产出，是可追踪的安全政策讨论入口；具体事件分析与建议仍应以所链接文章的原始证据为准。
items.abstract_zh: “放慢前沿”意味着什么？过去一个月里，我和 @random_walker 分析了 AI 公司发生的失控事件，以理解哪些技术和政策干预能够提升安全性，以及公司应当如何放慢前沿研发。结果是一篇新的 13,000 字文章——这是自《AI as Normal Technology》以来我们关于 AI 安全最实质性的写作。
items.author_line: Sayash Kapoor

items.title: @rasbt：Some food for thought when designing benchmarks... So, here's a little computer-use (visual) comparison between GPT-5.6
items.abstract_or_text: Some food for thought when designing benchmarks... So, here's a little computer-use (visual) comparison between GPT-5.6 Astra and Qwen3.8 Max. The task here was to recreate the image in the center using the Paint UI. Super interesting how the two different LLMs+Harnesses approached this totally differently by default. I.e., Astra tried to approach this by drawing and layering geometric shapes. Qwen approached this pixel by pixel. (Of course, the pixel-by-pixel result looks closer to the original, it's essentially a low-res version of that by nature.) So, the Qwen-generated image would surely score higher in the sense that it's closer to the original. But I wouldn’t conclude from this example that one LLM generalizes better than the other on other tasks. Also, I wouldn't say Qwen has better compute-use capabilities or better visual understanding than Astra. But it highlights an interesting point about how slippery benchmarks are when they only compare final results.
items.summary_zh: 事实：Sebastian Raschka 展示了 GPT-5.6 Astra 与 Qwen3.8 Max 在 Paint 界面复刻图像时采取的不同策略：前者绘制并叠加几何形状，后者逐像素生成。作者指出，后者更接近原图不等于其泛化、计算机使用或视觉理解能力更强。

items.title: @OmegaDesci：Today, we're announcing a solution to Ralf Stephan's 2003 conjecture on OEIS A005590, with a complete Lean proof develop
items.abstract_or_text: Today, we're announcing a solution to Ralf Stephan's 2003 conjecture on OEIS A005590, with a complete Lean proof developed by AI agents working within trureturing, our open-source mathematical research harness. A simple recurrence hides an exact binary law. Start with r(0) = 0 and r(1) = 1: r(2n) = r(n) r(2n + 1) = r(n + 1) - r(n) Replace that minus sign with a plus, and you get Stern's famous counting sequence. Keep the minus, and cancellation takes over. Where, exactly, are the zeros? On May 2, 2003, Ralf Stephan (@sweegol) recorded a striking conjecture: the zeros at indices 3n are governed entirely by the binary digits of n. The theorem, for every n ≥ 0: r(3n) = 0 if and only if binary(n) contains no adjacent 1s. 10 is 1010 in binary, so r(30) = 0. 11 is 1011, so r(33) = -4. The proof must rule out accidental cancellation at every depth of the recursion. Its key is an invariant of adjacent terms: if x = r(k) and y = r(k + 1), then x(x - y) ≥ 0, and x and y never vanish together. That forces the zero test to obey the same recursion as binary strings avoiding 11. Strong induction closes the equivalence for every natural number. The integers with those binary patterns are the fibbinary numbers, also linked to Zeckendorf's Fibonacci representation. A signed recurrence, a binary language, and a classical number system meet in one exact theorem. The conjectured connection is Stephan's. The complete formal proof is now open source.

items.title: Neural-Network Solutions to Real-Space Charge Density and Generalization
items.abstract_or_text: The Hohenberg-Kohn theorem establishes that, in principle, the ground state (GS) charge density contains all GS information of a many-electron system, such that all GS observables can be expressed as functionals of the GS charge density. Conventional Kohn-Sham density functional theory requires iterative solution of the self-consistent-field equations at substantial computational cost, motivating the development of deep learning surrogates for electronic structure calculations and, in turn, accelerating computer-aided materials design. Here, we propose AIDEN, an Atomic-Interaction Density Equivariant Network for solving real-space charge density. AIDEN separates the element-dependent one-center density from environment-induced density redistribution and represents the latter through complementary atom- and edge-centered tensor correlations. A continuous low-rank Gaussian decoder then reconstructs the density at arbitrary spatial coordinates while reusing atomic encodings independently of the evaluation grid. AIDEN achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on periodic crystal benchmarks while remaining competitive for molecular systems, and further demonstrates zero-shot transferability across several structurally distinct out-of-distribution case studies. Furthermore, AIDEN provides substantially faster inference than both baseline models and full SCF calculations, enabling efficient charge density reconstruction for large-scale electronic structure calculations.
items.summary_zh: AIDEN 以等变原子交互网络和连续低秩 Gaussian 解码器重建实空间电荷密度，在周期晶体基准上达到领先精度，并展示对结构分布外体系的零样本迁移及较 SCF 更快的推理。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 电荷密度是材料电子结构与性质预测的核心中间量；若其精度与迁移性可复现，该方法可降低大规模材料筛选的计算门槛。当前证据主要是计算基准和案例，尚非实验性质验证。
items.abstract_zh: Hohenberg-Kohn 定理确立：原则上，多电子体系的基态（GS）电荷密度包含全部基态信息，因此所有基态可观测量都可表示为基态电荷密度的泛函。传统 Kohn-Sham 密度泛函理论需要以很高的计算成本迭代求解自洽场方程，这推动了用于电子结构计算的深度学习代理模型的发展，进而加速计算机辅助材料设计。本文提出 AIDEN，即用于求解实空间电荷密度的 Atomic-Interaction Density Equivariant Network。AIDEN 将元素依赖的单中心密度与由环境诱导的密度重分布分开，并通过互补的原子中心和边中心张量关联表示后者。随后，连续低秩 Gaussian 解码器在任意空间坐标重建密度，同时使原子编码可独立于评估网格重复使用。AIDEN 在周期晶体基准上达到最先进准确度，在分子体系上也保持竞争力，并进一步在若干结构上不同的分布外案例研究中展示零样本迁移能力。此外，AIDEN 的推理速度显著快于基线模型和完整 SCF 计算，可为大规模电子结构计算提供高效的电荷密度重建。

items.title: Toward Predictive Hydride Bond Energetics with Neural-Network Wavefunctions
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate prediction of transition-metal hydride (TM-H) bond dissociation energies (BDEs) remains challenging because of strong electron correlation, relativistic effects, and nuclear quantum contributions. Here, we assess the performance of neural-network variational Monte Carlo (NN-VMC) based on the Psiformer ansatz for systems with increasing complexity (LiH, OH, TiH and NiH), and compare it against CCSDT(Q)/CBS as well as available theoretical and experimental data. Throughout this study, both NN-VMC and ab initio calculations employ a common ccECP Hamiltonian to enable tractable and consistent comparisons. To reduce finite-training errors, we introduce complementary zero-variance and infinite-step extrapolation schemes. For LiH and OH systems, NN-VMC yields total energies that differ within sub-milli Hartree compared to CBS extrapolated ab initio results and the BDE differences remain under 2σ. In case of Ti and TiH, the variational NN-VMC energies at the end of training are already consistent with CCSD(T)/CBS, while post-training extrapolation systematically closes the gap towards the CCSDT(Q)/CBS results. In contrast, NiH provides a stringent test of wavefunction expressivity, where increasing the number of determinants in NN-wavefunction ansatz improves the recovered correlation energy. The comparison of NiH BDE reveals that, while the existing theoretical predictions cluster into distinct high and low BDE groups, the broad scatter in available experimental data prevents a definitive assessment of the most accurate theoretical approach. This work demonstrates that NN-VMC with ccECPs Hamiltonian provides a competitive framework for quantitative prediction of main-group and early TM-H energetics, while identifying late TM-H as an important benchmark for future developments in neural-network wavefunctions and electronic structure theory.
items.summary_zh: 研究考察基于 Psiformer 的神经网络变分 Monte Carlo 对 LiH、OH、TiH 和 NiH 键解离能的预测，并通过零方差和无穷步外推减小训练误差，识别 NiH 为检验波函数表达能力的严格基准。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 过渡金属氢化物键能是强关联与相对论效应并存的电子结构难题；该工作提供了与 CCSDT(Q)/CBS 及实验的系统比较。NiH 实验数据分散且无法裁决最准确理论，限制了最终结论。
items.abstract_zh: 由于强电子关联、相对论效应和核量子贡献，准确预测过渡金属氢化物（TM-H）键解离能（BDE）仍具挑战性。本文评估基于 Psiformer ansatz 的神经网络变分 Monte Carlo（NN-VMC）对复杂度逐步增加体系（LiH、OH、TiH 和 NiH）的性能，并将其与 CCSDT(Q)/CBS 以及可获得的理论和实验数据比较。在整个研究中，NN-VMC 和从头算计算均采用共同的 ccECP Hamiltonian，以实现可处理且一致的比较。为减小有限训练误差，我们引入互补的零方差和无穷步外推方案。对于 LiH 和 OH 体系，NN-VMC 给出的总能量相对于 CBS 外推从头算结果的差异在亚毫 Hartree 范围内，BDE 差异保持在2σ以下。对于 Ti 和 TiH，训练结束时的变分 NN-VMC 能量已与 CCSD(T)/CBS 一致，而训练后外推系统性地缩小了与 CCSDT(Q)/CBS 结果的差距。相比之下，NiH 为波函数表达能力提供了严格测试：增加 NN 波函数 ansatz 中的行列式数目可改善恢复的关联能。NiH BDE 的比较揭示，现有理论预测聚集为不同的高、低 BDE 组，而可获得实验数据的广泛散布使得无法对最准确的理论方法作出决定性评估。本工作表明，采用 ccECP Hamiltonian 的 NN-VMC 为主族和早期过渡金属氢化物能量学的定量预测提供了有竞争力的框架，同时将晚期 TM-H 确认为未来神经网络波函数和电子结构理论发展的重要基准。

items.title: Multi-View Molecular Representation Learning with Hierarchical Graphs and Contextualized Fingerprints
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular property prediction requires representations that generalize from limited labeled data to structurally novel compounds. Existing molecular pretraining methods often rely on a single view: graph-based approaches model atom-bond topology but provide limited fragment-level supervision, whereas fingerprint descriptors encode chemical patterns but are typically used as fixed auxiliary features. We propose HiFi-Mol, a multi-view framework that separately pretrains a hierarchical graph encoder and a contextualized fingerprint encoder before downstream integration. The graph branch uses fragment-aware masking with multi-resolution supervision to capture substructure-aware representations, while the fingerprint branch tokenizes active entries from seven fingerprint families and applies masked language modeling to learn contextualized embeddings. During fine-tuning, HiFi-Mol combines projected multi-resolution graph features with fingerprint embeddings for downstream prediction. Evaluated on MoleculeNet benchmarks under the scaffold split, HiFi-Mol achieves a 2.77% improvement in average ROC-AUC over the best baseline across eight classification tasks while maintaining competitive performance on three regression tasks. Further analyses reveal that fragment-aware masking improves graph representation quality, and classification results demonstrate dataset-dependent strengths of the individual graph and fingerprint variants, confirming that the two views provide complementary predictive signals.
items.summary_zh: HiFi-Mol 分别预训练层级图编码器与上下文化指纹编码器，再在下游任务中融合多分辨率图特征和指纹嵌入；在 MoleculeNet scaffold split 的八项分类任务上平均 ROC-AUC 较最佳基线提升2.77%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法尝试将子结构层级监督与七类指纹的化学模式信息统一到分子表征学习中；结果依托公开基准，且回归任务仅称保持竞争力，尚需更严格的前瞻性质预测检验。
items.abstract_zh: 分子性质预测需要能够从有限标注数据泛化到结构新颖化合物的表示。现有分子预训练方法常依赖单一视图：基于图的方法建模原子—键拓扑，但提供的片段级监督有限；而指纹描述符编码化学模式，却通常作为固定的辅助特征使用。我们提出 HiFi-Mol，这是一个多视图框架，在下游整合前分别预训练层级图编码器和上下文化指纹编码器。图分支使用具有多分辨率监督的片段感知掩蔽，以捕捉具有子结构感知能力的表示；指纹分支对七个指纹家族中的活性条目进行分词，并应用掩蔽语言建模学习上下文化嵌入。在微调时，HiFi-Mol 将投影的多分辨率图特征与指纹嵌入结合用于下游预测。在 scaffold split 下的 MoleculeNet 基准评估中，HiFi-Mol 在八项分类任务上的平均 ROC-AUC 比最佳基线提高2.77%，同时在三项回归任务中保持竞争力。进一步分析显示，片段感知掩蔽可提高图表示质量，分类结果表明单独图和指纹变体的优势依赖于数据集，证实两种视图提供互补的预测信号。
items.author_line: Gwang-Hyeon Yun, Jong-Hoon Park, Bing Hu, Helen Chen, Anita Layton, Young-Rae Cho

items.title: Direct Synthesis of Covalent Organic Framework Monolayer via Ullmann Coupling on Non-metallic Substrates
items.abstract_or_text: Two-dimensional covalent organic framework monolayers are promising porous materials for electronic and optoelectronic applications owing to their periodic nanoporous architectures and tunable electronic structures. However, on-surface Ullmann coupling used to construct such frameworks typically relies on catalytic single-crystal metal substrates, whose strong electronic coupling can obscure the intrinsic properties of the molecular layer and complicate device integration. Here, we demonstrate substrate-engineered Ullmann coupling of 1,3,5-tris(4iodophenyl)benzene toward monolayer two-dimensional covalent organic networks on nonmetallic substrates. On inert highly oriented pyrolytic graphite, externally deposited Fe species promote C–I bond activation and covalent coupling, whereas FeO thin films enable network formation without additional metal deposition through defect-derived Fe active centers. Density functional theory calculations reveal that the energetically favored pathways on HOPG, FeO, and Au(111) all involve transient metal-centered intermediates that facilitate dehalogenation and C–C bond formation, although the catalytic centers originate from different sources. Bias-dependent scanning tunneling microscopy further shows that substrate coupling governs the visibility of frontier electronic states: weakly interacting HOPG preserves orbital-like features that closely resemble calculated frontier states of the freestanding framework, whereas stronger interactions on FeO and Au(111) progressively perturb or screen these states. These results establish nonmetallic substrates as viable platforms for on-surface Ullmann coupling and highlight substrate engineering as a strategy for accessing intrinsic electronic properties of two-dimensional covalent organic materials.
items.summary_zh: 研究在 HOPG 与 FeO 等非金属基底上实现1,3,5-tris(4iodophenyl)benzene 的 Ullmann 偶联，制备二维共价有机网络单层，并以 DFT 和偏压依赖 STM 揭示基底耦合对前沿电子态的影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它提出绕开强耦合单晶金属基底来获得二维 COF 本征电子态的实验路径，并同时给出机理计算和显微表征；工作主要针对特定前体和基底组合，器件整合与普适性尚待证明。
items.abstract_zh: 二维共价有机框架单层由于其周期性纳米多孔结构和可调电子结构，是用于电子和光电应用的有前景多孔材料。然而，用于构建此类框架的表面 Ullmann 偶联通常依赖催化性单晶金属基底，其强电子耦合可能掩盖分子层的本征性质，并使器件集成复杂化。本文展示了在非金属基底上，针对1,3,5-tris(4iodophenyl)benzene 的基底工程 Ullmann 偶联，以构建单层二维共价有机网络。在惰性的高定向热解石墨上，外部沉积的 Fe 物种促进 C–I 键活化和共价偶联；而 FeO 薄膜通过缺陷来源的 Fe 活性中心，无需额外金属沉积即可实现网络形成。密度泛函理论计算揭示，在 HOPG、FeO 和 Au(111) 上能量有利的路径均涉及短暂的金属中心中间体，其促进脱卤和 C–C 键形成，但催化中心来自不同来源。偏压依赖扫描隧道显微镜进一步显示，基底耦合控制前沿电子态的可见性：弱相互作用的 HOPG 保留了与自由框架计算前沿态密切相似的类轨道特征，而 FeO 和 Au(111) 上更强的相互作用逐渐扰动或屏蔽这些态。这些结果确立了非金属基底作为表面 Ullmann 偶联的可行平台，并强调基底工程是获得二维共价有机材料本征电子性质的一种策略。
items.author_line: Dong Nie, Jingyu He, Jinwei Fan, Siming Gu, Junqi He, Hafiza Saima Batoola, Ming Yang, Dingguan Wang

items.title: CARDIAC-FM: A Generalizable Multimodal Foundation Model Integrating ECG and Cardiac MRI
items.abstract_or_text: Atrial fibrillation and heart failure impose substantial health burdens worldwide, yet accurate and generalizable risk prediction remains challenging. Here we developed CARDIAC-FM, a multimodal foundation model that integrates 12-lead electrocardiography (ECG) and cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (cardiac MRI) through self-supervised representation learning and cross-modal contrastive alignment. CARDIAC-FM introduces a self-supervised spatiotemporal, multi-view masked autoencoder for cardiac MRI. Developed on 57,609 paired ECG-cardiac MRI samples from UK Biobank, CARDIAC-FM improved prediction of incident atrial fibrillation and heart failure over contemporary ECG AI models and generalized zero-shot to two external cohorts, the Cardiovascular Health Study and the Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis. Combining its ECG representation with established clinical risk scores further improved discrimination across cohorts, supporting complementary prognostic information from ECG and traditional risk factors. Beyond atrial fibrillation and heart failure, the learned representation transferred to continuous cardiac MRI phenotype prediction, time-to-event modelling and prediction of additional cardiovascular outcomes with limited fine-tuning, including myocardial infarction, ischaemic stroke, cardiovascular death and all-cause mortality. Although pre-trained with paired ECG and cardiac MRI, the model can be deployed using ECG alone, with additional predictive gains when cardiac MRI is available. These findings demonstrate the promise of multimodal self-supervised learning for generalizable cardiovascular risk prediction.
items.summary_zh: CARDIAC-FM 在 57,609 对 UK Biobank ECG—心脏 MRI 样本上预训练，并报告对房颤和心力衰竭风险预测的改进及在两个外部队列中的零样本泛化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大规模配对多模态预训练加外部队列评估，为 ECG 与心脏 MRI 融合的可迁移风险预测提供较强证据；仍是预印本中的预测研究，不证明临床获益。
items.abstract_zh: 心房颤动和心力衰竭在全球造成沉重健康负担，但准确且可泛化的风险预测仍具挑战性。本文开发了 CARDIAC-FM，这是一种多模态基础模型，通过自监督表征学习和跨模态对比对齐整合 12 导联心电图（ECG）与心脏磁共振成像（心脏 MRI）。CARDIAC-FM 引入了用于心脏 MRI 的自监督时空多视图掩码自编码器。在来自 UK Biobank 的 57,609 对 ECG—心脏 MRI 样本上开发后，CARDIAC-FM 对新发心房颤动和心力衰竭的预测优于当代 ECG AI 模型，并可零样本泛化至两个外部队列，即 Cardiovascular Health Study 和 Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis。将其 ECG 表征与既有临床风险评分结合，进一步改善了各队列的区分能力，支持 ECG 与传统风险因素提供互补的预后信息。除心房颤动和心力衰竭外，所学习的表征还能迁移至连续心脏 MRI 表型预测、时间至事件建模，以及在有限微调下预测其他心血管结局，包括心肌梗死、缺血性卒中、心血管死亡和全因死亡。尽管使用配对 ECG 和心脏 MRI 进行预训练，该模型可仅用 ECG 部署；在有心脏 MRI 时可获得额外预测增益。这些结果表明，多模态自监督学习有望用于可泛化的心血管风险预测。
