items.title: TransBind2: Improving Transcription Factor-DNA Binding Prediction with Multimodal Data and Bidirectional Cross Attention
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate genome-wide prediction of transcription factor (TF)-DNA binding remains challenging because many models focus mainly on DNA sequence and overlook chromatin context and TF structure. We previously developed TransBind, a protein-aware model that combines TF and DNA representations through cross-attention. Here, we introduce TransBind2, which improves on TransBind in several ways. It incorporates DNase-seq accessibility and genome mappability tracks as additional input, uses a biomodal protein language model (ProstT5) to capture both TF sequence and structure, and applies bidirectional cross-attention so DNA and protein features can refine each other. We also frame prediction as binary classification of individual triplets, allowing the model to generalize to new TFs and cell types. Across 690 human ChIP-seq experiments covering 161 TFs and 91 cell types, TransBind2 achieves a macro AUROC of 0.9648 and AUPR of 0.4215, outperforming TransBind and other baselines, with a ≥12.67% relative AUPR gain. The model trained on human data also performs well in cross-species zero-shot prediction on mouse data. Saliency analysis shows that it can identify TF-binding peaks with a median error of 12-38 base pairs (bps) despite being trained on window-level labels. Ablation studies further show that TF structure, chromatin accessibility, and bidirectional attention each improve performance. Overall, these results show that combining TF structure with chromatin context leads to more accurate and generalizable TF-DNA binding predictions.
items.summary_zh: TransBind2 将 DNase-seq 可及性、基因组可比对性、ProstT5 的 TF 序列—结构表示与双向交叉注意力结合，在 690 个 ChIP-seq 实验中报告宏平均 AUROC 0.9648。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该模型将蛋白结构与染色质语境共同用于 TF-DNA 结合预测，并给出跨物种零样本和消融评估；当前结论仍限于计算基准性能。
items.abstract_zh: 准确的全基因组转录因子（TF）-DNA 结合预测仍具挑战性，因为许多模型主要关注 DNA 序列，而忽略染色质语境和 TF 结构。我们此前开发了 TransBind，这是一种通过交叉注意力结合 TF 和 DNA 表示的蛋白质感知模型。本文介绍 TransBind2，其在多个方面改进了 TransBind。它将 DNase-seq 可及性和基因组可比对性轨道作为附加输入，使用双模态蛋白质语言模型（ProstT5）同时捕获 TF 序列和结构，并应用双向交叉注意力，使 DNA 和蛋白质特征能够彼此细化。我们还将预测表述为单个三元组的二分类任务，使模型可泛化至新的 TF 和细胞类型。在覆盖 161 个 TF 和 91 种细胞类型的 690 个 ChIP-seq 实验中，TransBind2 达到 0.9648 的宏平均 AUROC 和 0.4215 的 AUPR，优于 TransBind 和其他基线，AUPR 相对提升至少 12.67%。在小鼠数据上，该模型在由人类数据训练后的跨物种零样本预测中也表现良好。显著性分析表明，尽管模型以窗口级标签训练，它仍能以 12-38 个碱基对（bps）的中位误差识别 TF 结合峰。消融研究进一步表明，TF 结构、染色质可及性和双向注意力各自均能提升性能。总体而言，这些结果表明，将 TF 结构与染色质语境结合可带来更准确且更具泛化性的 TF-DNA 结合预测。
items.author_line: Basnet S, Cheng J

items.title: Heterogeneous graph neural networks with biological prior knowledge for interpretable drug repurposing in triple-negative breast cancer
items.abstract_or_text: Drug repurposing offers a cost-effective path to new therapies for triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), a subtype with limited targeted treatment options. We present PRECISION, a framework integrating transcription factor (TF) regulatory networks, protein-protein interactions, and drug-target edges into a heterogeneous graph neural network (GNN) to identify TFs mediating drug sensitivity and prioritize repurposing candidates. The knowledge graph has 23,498 nodes and approximately 830,000 edges from CollecTRI, OmniPath and the PRISM screen. In a fair cell-line hold-out evaluation, the GNN matches ML baselines in global prediction (Pearson r = 0.76). Per-drug mechanistic attributions via Integrated Gradients on the trained GNN, replicated across three independent training seeds and robust to baseline choice (Spearman's rho = 0.94 between the mean and the random Gaussian baselines), highlight stress-response (CREB3L1), epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT; KLF8, ZEB1), stromal/TNBC-specific (AEBP1, MZF1), and epithelial (SPDEF) regulators as stable mediators of drug response. Multi-cohort validation in SCAN-B (n = 7,397), METABRIC (n = 1,979), and TCGA-BRCA (n = 1,072) shows that predicted drug sensitivity is associated with overall survival in 623 drugs in SCAN-B and 74 in METABRIC (FDR < 0.05). Fisher's meta-analysis identifies 551 drugs at FDR < 0.05, validated by positive controls paclitaxel (p_adj = 8.6x10-3), docetaxel (3.1x10-2), epirubicin (3.2x10-6), and talazoparib (1.4x10-4). Paired Wilcoxon tests in 39 AURORA-US patients with matched primary and metastatic samples confirm that 4 of the 10 IG-identified TFs (CREB3L1, KLF8, AEBP1, SPDEF) are significantly altered during metastatic progression after Bonferroni correction. An explicit rule applied to the PAM50-adjusted Cox multivariate results (penalizer = 0.1) selects seven candidates (osimertinib, saracatinib, erlotinib, brigatinib, pelitinib, entinostat, trametinib), revealing pharmacological convergence on the EGFR signaling axis.
items.summary_zh: PRECISION 在 23,498 个节点、约 830,000 条边的异构知识图上整合调控网络、蛋白互作和药物—靶点边，用于三阴性乳腺癌药物再定位及机制归因。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作使用细胞系留出、多队列关联和转移配对样本评估，提出 EGFR 轴收敛的候选药物；生存关联和模型归因不构成药物疗效或机制因果证据。
items.abstract_zh: 药物再定位为三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）提供了通向新疗法的成本效益路径；TNBC 是一种靶向治疗选择有限的亚型。我们提出 PRECISION 框架，将转录因子（TF）调控网络、蛋白—蛋白相互作用和药物—靶点边整合至异构图神经网络（GNN），以识别介导药物敏感性的 TF 并优先排序再定位候选物。该知识图谱包含 23,498 个节点和约 830,000 条边，数据来自 CollecTRI、OmniPath 和 PRISM 筛选。在公平的细胞系留出评估中，该 GNN 在全局预测上与 ML 基线相当（Pearson r = 0.76）。在训练后的 GNN 上采用 Integrated Gradients 进行逐药机制归因，且在三个独立训练随机种子中得到重复、并对基线选择稳健（平均基线与随机高斯基线之间的 Spearman's rho = 0.94）；结果突出显示应激反应（CREB3L1）、上皮—间质转化（EMT；KLF8、ZEB1）、基质/TNBC 特异性（AEBP1、MZF1）和上皮性（SPDEF）调控因子，是稳定的药物反应介导者。对 SCAN-B（n = 7,397）、METABRIC（n = 1,979）和 TCGA-BRCA（n = 1,072）进行多队列验证显示，在 SCAN-B 中，预测的药物敏感性与 623 种药物的总生存相关；在 METABRIC 中，与 74 种药物相关（FDR < 0.05）。Fisher Meta 分析识别出 551 种 FDR < 0.05 的药物，并由阳性对照 paclitaxel（p_adj = 8.6x10-3）、docetaxel（3.1x10-2）、epirubicin（3.2x10-6）和 talazoparib（1.4x10-4）验证。在 39 名具有配对原发和转移样本的 AURORA-US 患者中，配对 Wilcoxon 检验确认 10 个由 IG 识别的 TF 中有 4 个（CREB3L1、KLF8、AEBP1、SPDEF）在 Bonferroni 校正后于转移进程中显著改变。应用于 PAM50 校正 Cox 多变量结果的显式规则（penalizer = 0.1）选出七个候选物（osimertinib、saracatinib、erlotinib、brigatinib、pelitinib、entinostat、trametinib），显示药理学上向 EGFR 信号轴收敛。
items.author_line: Fernandez-Lozano C, Ferreiro D, V.-del-Rio P

items.title: The Multimodal Anonymizer: a fully local multi-agent AI system for medical data deidentification
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Safe reuse of multimodal hospital data for AI development is limited by the absence of reliable, context-aware deidentification across multimodal data and longitudinal patient data. Existing approaches are largely modality-specific and can indiscriminately remove clinically important information. Methods: We developed the Multimodal Anonymizer, a modular, locally deployable multi-agent framework integrating multimodal large language models, task-specific neural networks and rule-based transformations. We evaluated 16 orchestrator model configurations on a benchmark built from publicly available data and hospital data from our institution. The benchmark dataset included data from different origins: 250 MIMIC-IV patients with synthetically injected personally identifiable information (PII) supplemented with head CT, face images, handwriting, audio, German clinical-text datasets and local data. Primary outcomes were deidentification sensitivity and preservation of clinically important content; secondary analyses examined model characteristics, reproducibility, and performance against leading market and open-source solutions. Results: The best local configuration (the orchestrator being Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking) achieved near-complete deidentification across all datasets, with per-patient sensitivity of 98.80% (95%-CI 97.20; 100), and per-PII sensitivity of 99.82% (95%-CI 99.76; 99.88). Critical clinical preservation was 99.60% (95%-CI 98.80; 100) per-patient, and clinical preservation was 99.61% (95%-CI 99.51; 99.71) per-file. All modalities achieved at least 98.30% sensitivity (lower bound 95%-CI). On our local data, the system achieved a deidentification sensitivity of 100% per-patient and per-PII; and a critical clinical preservation of 100% per-patient as well as a clinical preservation of 99.97% (95%-CI 99.91; 100) per-file. When comparing orchestrators, the leading local models were similar to proprietary models (GPT-5.2) in deidentification sensitivity while showing higher deidentification specificity. The Multimodal Anonymizer outperformed previous tools on most modalities. Conclusion: Near-complete, utility-preserving deidentification of multimodal clinical data is achievable with a unified, locally deployable multi-agent system, enabling safer large-scale reuse of hospital data for research and AI development.
items.summary_zh: 该本地可部署多 Agent 去标识化系统在含 250 名 MIMIC-IV 患者、影像、音频、手写和临床文本的数据基准上，报告高 PII 去除敏感性及临床内容保留率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 多模态、纵向数据去标识化是医院数据再利用的基础能力；结果包含本地数据，但需独立审计其隐私失效模式、实际工作流与跨机构可复现性。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：用于 AI 开发的多模态医院数据的安全再利用，受限于缺乏可靠、具语境意识的多模态和纵向患者数据去标识化方法。现有方法大多是模态特异性的，并可能不加区分地移除具有临床重要性的信息。方法：我们开发了 Multimodal Anonymizer，这是一种模块化、可本地部署的多 Agent 框架，整合多模态大语言模型、任务特异性神经网络和基于规则的转换。我们在由公开数据和本机构医院数据构成的基准上评估了 16 种编排器模型配置。基准数据集包含不同来源的数据：250 名带有合成注入个人可识别信息（PII）的 MIMIC-IV 患者，以及头颅 CT、面部图像、手写、音频、德国临床文本数据集和本地数据。主要结局为去标识化敏感性和具有临床重要性内容的保留；次要分析考察模型特征、可复现性，以及相对于领先商业和开源解决方案的性能。结果：最佳本地配置（编排器为 Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking）在所有数据集上实现近乎完全的去标识化，患者级敏感性为 98.80%（95% CI 97.20；100），PII 级敏感性为 99.82%（95% CI 99.76；99.88）。患者级关键临床内容保留率为 99.60%（95% CI 98.80；100），文件级临床内容保留率为 99.61%（95% CI 99.51；99.71）。所有模态的敏感性均至少为 98.30%（95% CI 下限）。在我们的本地数据上，该系统在患者级和 PII 级均达到 100% 的去标识化敏感性；患者级关键临床内容保留率也为 100%，文件级临床内容保留率为 99.97%（95% CI 99.91；100）。比较编排器时，领先的本地模型在去标识化敏感性上与专有模型（GPT-5.2）相近，同时显示更高的去标识化特异性。Multimodal Anonymizer 在多数模态上优于既有工具。结论：通过统一、可本地部署的多 Agent 系统，可以实现近乎完全且保留效用的多模态临床数据去标识化，从而使医院数据能够更安全地大规模再利用于研究和 AI 开发。
items.author_line: Hirsch, A., Ten, F. W., Krueger, K. S., Geyer, R., Roeschl, T., Groeschel, M., Rostin, P., Eils, R., Spott, M., Prasser, F., Meyer, A., Madrid, J.

items.title: EEG-Xplain: Decoding Neural Black-Boxes of EEG Foundation Models
items.abstract_or_text: EEG foundation models such as BIOT, LaBraM, and EEGMamba have achieved remarkable performance in neural signal decoding, but their black-box nature limits clinical trust and neuroscientific validation. We propose a unified attribution framework for interpreting EEG foundation models across heterogeneous architectures. The framework integrates gradient-, perturbation-, and activation-based explanation methods to analyze model behavior in spatial, temporal, and frequency dimensions. Spatially, it identifies critical EEG channels and visualizes their distributions using topographic maps. Temporally, it highlights decision-relevant signal segments through attribution heatmaps. In the frequency domain, it quantifies the contributions of canonical EEG rhythms via spectral perturbation analysis. To assess explanation reliability, we introduce a population-level evaluation combining Area Over the Perturbation Curve (AOPC) and cross-method consistency analysis. The framework further leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to transform structured attribution outputs into natural-language reports, bridging low-level neural representations and high-level semantic reasoning. Experiments on benchmark datasets, including Mumtaz2016 and TUAB, demonstrate that the generated explanations are consistent with established neurophysiological markers, validating meaningful neural representations while exposing potential dependencies on artifacts and spurious patterns. The proposed framework provides a standardized approach for evaluating the interpretability, reliability, and physiological plausibility of EEG foundation models.
items.summary_zh: EEG-Xplain 结合梯度、扰动和激活归因，在空间、时间与频率维度解释 EEG 基础模型，并以 AOPC 和跨方法一致性评估解释可靠性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 解释框架将神经生理合理性、伪影依赖和模型解释稳定性纳入评估；其临床可信度仍需在真实前瞻性工作流中检验。
items.abstract_zh: BIOT、LaBraM 和 EEGMamba 等 EEG 基础模型在神经信号解码中取得了显著性能，但其黑箱性质限制了临床信任和神经科学验证。我们提出一个统一归因框架，用于解释跨异构架构的 EEG 基础模型。该框架整合基于梯度、扰动和激活的解释方法，以在空间、时间和频率维度分析模型行为。在空间上，它识别关键 EEG 通道，并用拓扑图可视化其分布。在时间上，它通过归因热图突出与决策相关的信号片段。在频率域中，它通过频谱扰动分析量化经典 EEG 节律的贡献。为评估解释可靠性，我们引入将扰动曲线下面积（AOPC）与跨方法一致性分析结合的人群层面评估。该框架还利用大语言模型（LLMs）将结构化归因输出转换为自然语言报告，从而连接低层神经表征和高层语义推理。在包括 Mumtaz2016 和 TUAB 在内的基准数据集上的实验显示，生成的解释与既有神经生理标志物一致，既验证了有意义的神经表征，也暴露了对伪影和虚假模式的潜在依赖。所提框架为评估 EEG 基础模型的可解释性、可靠性和生理合理性提供了标准化方法。
items.author_line: Hansong Ma, Junxiao Wang

items.title: Improving Mathematical Reasoning Capabilities in Large Language Models via Reasoning Process Error Classification
items.abstract_or_text: The reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs) is a critical factor for practical LLM-based applications. To investigate the current reasoning capability of LLMs, we clarify the types of errors that arise in LLMs' reasoning processes on mathematical datasets. We focus on problems where LLMs produce an incorrect answer. We define errors in the reasoning process as reasoning errors and manually analyze the features of reasoning errors. We defined and classified 21 error classes and identified the frequently occurring classes among them. Beyond qualitative evaluation, we leverage the evaluation results to improve the reasoning capability. We designed a prompt that explicitly focuses on eight error classes. The experiments demonstrate that this prompt effectively improves reasoning performance. Furthermore, the results suggest that the frequent reasoning errors identified in this paper are common across LLMs of comparable scale.
items.summary_zh: 研究人工标注并归类数学题错误答案中的 21 类推理过程错误，再将其中八类错误写入提示词以测试性能变化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把笼统的“推理失败”转为可审阅的错误分类和干预实验；摘要未给出各数据集的具体增益，故只能将其视为诊断与提示设计的初步证据。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）的推理能力是实际 LLM 应用的关键因素。为考察当前 LLM 的推理能力，我们澄清 LLM 在数学数据集上的推理过程中出现的错误类型。我们聚焦于 LLM 给出错误答案的问题。我们将推理过程中的错误定义为推理错误，并人工分析推理错误的特征。我们定义并分类了 21 个错误类别，并识别出其中频繁出现的类别。除定性评估外，我们还利用评估结果提升推理能力。我们设计了一个显式聚焦于八类错误的提示词。实验表明，该提示词能有效提升推理性能。此外，结果表明，本文识别出的高频推理错误在规模相近的 LLM 之间具有共性。
items.author_line: Runa Yoshida, Kosuke Nishida, Kyosuke Nishida

items.title: Bellman Policy Optimization
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). We introduce Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO), a critic-free method derived from Policy Mirror Descent (PMD). For autoregressive generation with terminal rewards, BPO uses the Bellman equations to reformulate PMD as a trajectory-level objective. The reformulation avoids estimating state values at intermediate states. We prove that it has the same unique optimal solution as the original PMD objective. We derive the practical BPO loss by approximating this objective. Its mismatch-correction weight is a smoothed ratio of complementary token probabilities. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of BPO.
items.summary_zh: Bellman Policy Optimization（BPO）从 Policy Mirror Descent 推导无 critic 的轨迹级目标，并证明该目标与原始 PMD 目标具有相同的唯一最优解。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作同时给出优化目标的明确理论命题和数学推理基准实验，是区分训练目标性质与经验效果的可审阅对象；摘要没有提供完整的逐基准数值。
items.abstract_zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）能够提升大语言模型（LLMs）的推理能力。我们提出 Bellman Policy Optimization（BPO），一种从 Policy Mirror Descent（PMD）推导出的无 critic 方法。对于具有终端奖励的自回归生成，BPO 使用 Bellman 方程将 PMD 重写为轨迹级目标。该重写避免在中间状态估计状态价值。我们证明，它与原始 PMD 目标具有相同的唯一最优解。我们通过近似这一目标推导出实用的 BPO 损失。其失配校正权重是互补 token 概率的平滑比率。数学推理基准上的实验展示了 BPO 的有效性。
items.author_line: Zhuoqing Song, Haotian Xu, Xikun Zhang, Lidong Bing

items.title: Multimodal deep learning from spectra for small-molecule structure identification: enhancing robustness with mixed-condition training
items.abstract_or_text: In practical molecular characterization, small-molecule structure identification benefits from complementary spectroscopic evidence, but missing, degraded, or mismatched spectra challenge multimodal models. Herein, we incorporate domain knowledge from spectroscopy and chemistry into mixed-condition training for candidate structure reranking, using a reproducible evaluation protocol and mixture-of-experts (MoE) fusion. The protocol incorporates perturbations tailored to each spectroscopic modality and chemically informed spectrum replacements to cover variations in spectral availability, quality, and consistency. A total of 79,462 test samples were evaluated across 30 predefined conditions using simulated spectra from the Multimodal Spectroscopic Dataset (MSSD) for mass spectrometry (MS), infrared (IR) spectroscopy, and 1H and 13C nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), with up to 128 hard candidate structures per sample. A controlled two-by-two factorial comparison of complete-input training versus mixed-condition training and vanilla concatenation versus MoE fusion, with matched evaluation conditions, showed that mixed-condition training provided the main gains in both architectures. For MoE, mean reciprocal rank (MRR), averaged equally across conditions, increased from 0.9203 to 0.9763, a relative increase of 6.08%. Recall at rank 1 (R@1), averaged over the same conditions, increased from 89.50% to 96.36%, an increase of 6.86 percentage points and a relative increase of 7.67%. IR-only and MS/MS-only MRR increased from 0.4337 to 0.9307 and from 0.3711 to 0.8575, reaching 2.15 and 2.31 times their respective baseline values, while complete-input performance remained high. These results support integrating domain knowledge into training-condition design to improve robustness, with further gains from MoE under mixed-condition training.
items.summary_zh: 该研究以混合条件训练和 mixture-of-experts 融合提升 MS、IR、1H NMR 与13C NMR 多模态谱图驱动的小分子候选结构重排序，在缺失、低质量或不一致谱图下保持较强鲁棒性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 对实际结构鉴定中常见的谱图不完整问题给出可量化的训练设计方案，并在大规模受控条件下报告明显增益；但评测使用模拟 MSSD 谱图，向真实仪器数据和开放世界候选空间的外推仍待检验。
items.abstract_zh: 在实际分子表征中，小分子结构鉴定受益于互补的光谱证据，但缺失、退化或不匹配的谱图会给多模态模型带来挑战。本文将来自光谱学和化学的领域知识纳入用于候选结构重排序的混合条件训练，采用可复现的评估方案和 mixture-of-experts（MoE）融合。该方案纳入了针对各光谱模态的扰动以及具有化学信息的谱图替换，以覆盖光谱可用性、质量和一致性的变化。使用多模态光谱数据集（MSSD）中用于质谱（MS）、红外（IR）光谱以及1H和13C核磁共振（NMR）的模拟谱图，在30个预先定义的条件下评估了共79,462个测试样本；每个样本最多有128个困难候选结构。对完整输入训练与混合条件训练、以及普通拼接与 MoE 融合所作的受控二乘二因子比较，采用匹配的评估条件，表明混合条件训练在两种架构中提供了主要增益。对于 MoE，在各条件上等权平均的平均倒数排名（MRR）从0.9203升至0.9763，相对提高6.08%。在相同条件上平均的排名第1召回率（R@1）从89.50%升至96.36%，提高6.86个百分点、相对提高7.67%。仅 IR 和仅 MS/MS 的 MRR 分别从0.4337和0.3711升至0.9307和0.8575，分别达到各自基线的2.15和2.31倍，而完整输入性能仍然较高。这些结果支持将领域知识融入训练条件设计以提高鲁棒性，MoE 在混合条件下可带来进一步增益。
items.author_line: Bowen Gao, Lei Zhu, Yiying Wang, Wenjie Yu

items.title: Func-R1: Incentivizing Mathematical Function Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Performing deliberate mathematical reasoning in visual contexts is a hallmark of advanced Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and requires a sophisticated synthesis of perceptual grounding and symbolic logic. However, in the realm of mathematical functions, our investigation reveals a critical modality interference phenomenon: even advanced models, while performing textual computational reasoning, tend to disregard or misinterpret essential visual cues. To address this challenge, we propose Func-R1, which synergistically harmonizes precise visual perception and rigorous logical reasoning. Concretely, built upon an explicitly decoupled architecture, we employ a hierarchical post-training framework to progressively identify critical visual evidence and conduct in-depth theoretical reasoning. Furthermore, the Perception-Aligned Theoretic Optimization (PATO) strategy is proposed to steer policy updating towards internalizing fundamental theoretical properties while dynamically rectifying heterogeneous visual information throughout the reasoning process. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that Func-R1 delivers the optimal performance among open-source MLLMs, even surpassing GPT-5 with an 8.4% improvement on MathVerse's function-oriented tasks.
items.summary_zh: Func-R1 面向图像中函数题的多模态数学推理，通过解耦架构、分层后训练和 PATO 同时处理视觉证据与理论推理。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究将任务限定为 MathVerse 的函数相关问题，并报告了相对比较结果；这支持对该特定视觉数学任务的考察，不足以证明模型具备通用数学推理能力。
items.abstract_zh: 在视觉语境中进行审慎的数学推理是高级 Multimodal Large Language Models（MLLMs）的标志，并且需要复杂地综合感知落地和符号逻辑。然而，在数学函数领域，我们的研究揭示了一种关键的模态干扰现象：即使是先进模型在进行文本计算推理时，也倾向于忽略或误解必要的视觉线索。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 Func-R1，使精确视觉感知与严格逻辑推理协同一致。具体而言，基于显式解耦的架构，我们采用分层后训练框架，逐步识别关键视觉证据并进行深入理论推理。此外，我们提出 Perception-Aligned Theoretic Optimization（PATO）策略，引导策略更新内化基础理论性质，同时在推理过程中动态校正异质视觉信息。跨多种基准的大量实验表明，Func-R1 在开源 MLLMs 中表现最佳，甚至在 MathVerse 的函数导向任务上以 8.4% 的提升超过 GPT-5。
items.author_line: Mingze Yin, Xiaohan Wang, Dian Li, Haichao Yao, Yilin Zhao, Youjun Chen, Gang Liu, Jintai Chen, Yiheng Zhu, Chang-Yu Hsieh, Aimin Pan

items.title: RAGCell: Retrieval-Augmented Generation as Supervision for Versatile Single-cell Analysis
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell foundation models (scFMs) are transforming computational biology by enabling generalizable, task-agnostic representations for versatile single-cell analysis. Despite their progress in facilitating rapid deployment for downstream tasks, off-the-shelf scFMs still have some overlooked concerns: (I) (Pretraining Cost.) Pretrain-based scFMs necessitate pretraining on a vast volume of cells, rendering it draining resources in applications. (II) (Heterogeneous Gap.) Large Language Models (LLM)-based scFMs ignore the tremendous heterogeneous gap between LLM textual and raw cellular spaces, leading to insufficient capability when facing downstream tasks. To this end, we introduce RAGCell, a versatile single-cell analysis framework that achieves a double-win in both cost-effectiveness and high performance. The success of RAGCell lies in two key aspects: Leveraging LLMs to construct cell-level and feature-level knowledge databases, which serve as supervision signals for training the cell model and significantly reduce the training cost (>pretrain-based scFMs). Aligning cell representations with text embeddings from the bi-level knowledge databases, enabling knowledge transfer from textual spaces to cellular spaces and effectively mitigating the heterogeneous gap (>LLM-based scFMs). Through extensive experiments on six downstream single-cell analysis tasks, we demonstrate that RAGCell achieves outstanding performance compared to state-of-the-art scFMs while operating at less than \sim1/10 the cost of pretrain-based scFMs.
items.summary_zh: RAGCell 以 LLM 构建细胞级和特征级知识库作为监督信号，并将细胞表征与文本嵌入对齐；作者在六项下游单细胞任务中报告其性能优于现有 scFM。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法尝试以检索增强监督降低单细胞基础模型的预训练成本并缩小文本—细胞表征鸿沟；成本与性能主张目前来自预印本基准，需独立复现。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞基础模型（scFMs）正通过为通用单细胞分析提供可泛化、任务无关的表征而改变计算生物学。尽管它们促进了下游任务的快速部署，现成的 scFMs 仍有一些被忽视的问题：（I）（预训练成本。）基于预训练的 scFMs 需要在大量细胞上预训练，使其在应用中消耗大量资源。（II）（异质性鸿沟。）基于大语言模型（LLM）的 scFMs 忽略了 LLM 文本空间与原始细胞空间之间巨大的异质性鸿沟，在面对下游任务时导致能力不足。为此，我们引入 RAGCell，这是一种通用单细胞分析框架，在成本效益和高性能两方面实现双赢。RAGCell 的成功在于两个关键方面：利用 LLM 构建细胞级和特征级知识数据库，将其作为训练细胞模型的监督信号，并显著降低训练成本（优于基于预训练的 scFMs）。将来自双层知识数据库的文本嵌入与细胞表征对齐，使知识可从文本空间迁移至细胞空间，并有效缓解异质性鸿沟（优于基于 LLM 的 scFMs）。通过在六项下游单细胞分析任务上进行广泛实验，我们表明 RAGCell 相比最先进 scFMs 取得突出性能，同时其运行成本低于基于预训练 scFMs 的约 1/10。
items.author_line: Tianyu Liu, Fan Zhang, Jiayuan Chen, Kun Wang, Haoxuan Li, Shengju Qian, Zhihong Zhu, Donghao Zhou, Hao Wu, Ziheng Zhang, Zhenxi Lin, Xian Wu, Yefeng Zheng

items.title: RS-CIDER: A non-local machine learning model for approximating screened hybrid functionals
items.abstract_or_text: Screened hybrid functionals such as HSE06 improve the description of band gaps, charge localization, and redox energetics relative to semilocal approximations, but their explicit Hartree-Fock exchange term is computationally costly for large, periodic systems, especially in plane-wave basis set calculations. Here we present RS-CIDER, a machine-learned non-local exchange functional that approximates the short-range Hartree-Fock exchange term in HSE06 by explicitly fitting both ground-state energies and single-particle energy levels. RS-CIDER combines scale-invariant semilocal and non-local density descriptors and can be evaluated self-consistently without explicitly applying the short-range Hartree-Fock exchange operator. RS-CIDER shows close agreement with HSE06 for molecular reaction energies and solid-state band gaps. Further tests across distinct materials show agreement between RS-CIDER and HSE06 for local magnetism, Cu-O phase competition, polaron localization, and neutral-defect energetics. For an Fe olivine, chemistry-specific fine-tuning recovers the HSE06 Li intercalation voltage. A timing benchmark shows that RS-CIDER reduces the measured per-SCF-step wall time by more than an order of magnitude relative to HSE06. Together, these molecular and solid-state results establish RS-CIDER as an efficient self-consistent machine-learned surrogate for HSE06.
items.summary_zh: RS-CIDER 学习近程 Hartree–Fock 交换以近似 HSE06，并以能量和单粒子能级共同拟合；在反应能、带隙、磁性、缺陷与嵌锂电压等测试中接近 HSE06，且每个 SCF 步骤速度提高一个数量级以上。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它瞄准混合泛函在周期材料体系中的主要成本瓶颈，覆盖分子与固体的多类电子结构性质；化学特异微调对 Fe olivine 才恢复电压，提示跨体系泛化仍应逐一验证。
items.abstract_zh: HSE06 等屏蔽杂化泛函相较半局域近似，可改善对带隙、电荷局域化和氧化还原能量学的描述；但其显式 Hartree-Fock 交换项对于大型周期体系计算代价高昂，尤其是在平面波基组计算中。本文提出 RS-CIDER，这是一种机器学习非局域交换泛函，通过同时拟合基态能量和单粒子能级来近似 HSE06 中的短程 Hartree-Fock 交换项。RS-CIDER 结合了尺度不变的半局域与非局域密度描述符，并且无需显式施加短程 Hartree-Fock 交换算符即可自洽评估。RS-CIDER 对分子反应能和固体带隙显示出与 HSE06 的密切一致。对不同材料的进一步测试显示，RS-CIDER 与 HSE06 在局域磁性、Cu–O 相竞争、极化子局域化和中性缺陷能量学方面一致。对于一种 Fe olivine，化学特异性微调恢复了 HSE06 的 Li 嵌入电压。计时基准表明，相对于 HSE06，RS-CIDER 将测得的每个 SCF 步骤墙钟时间降低了一个数量级以上。总体而言，这些分子和固体结果确立了 RS-CIDER 作为 HSE06 的高效自洽机器学习代理模型。
items.author_line: Zhuotao Jin, Mohamed S. Abdallah, Boris Kozinsky, Kyle Bystrom

items.title: Operational Range Bounding in Spectroscopy: A Safety Cage Framework for Machine Learning Models
items.abstract_or_text: Ensuring the reliability of black-box machine learning models in safety-critical space missions remains a significant challenge, particularly when ground-truth is unavailable for validation. Although machine learning models offer a powerful means to augment standard pipelines by extracting transmission spectra from complex exoplanetary light curves, their susceptibility to unmodelled instrument anomalies, stellar activity, and domain shifts introduces unquantified risks. This study evaluates a modular safety cage architecture that operates as a parallel monitoring layer to assess the validity of a prediction without modifying the underlying estimator. By monitoring different runtime indicators, including uncertainty quantification, out-of-domain detection, and influence functions, the framework constrains the model's operational domain to a verified region. A controlled evaluation is conducted under both in-domain and cross-domain conditions, using datasets from the 2019 and 2021 editions of the Ariel Data Challenges. The results reveal that model failure is multifaceted and that no single indicator captures all failure modes, demonstrating the need for indicator fusion. The application of safety-driven rejection strategies shows that a modest 20% reduction in data coverage results in error reductions between 45% and 65% across different domains and evaluation metrics. Using a formalised coverage-risk framework, a systematic analysis of indicator combinations is performed to identify configurations that maximise risk-ranking accuracy and optimise the trade-off between data coverage and scientific performance. Safety cages provide a transparent mechanism for detecting unreliable predictions and represent a critical step towards the safe deployment of data-driven models in scientific applications, such as astrophysics, where ground truth is seldom available.
items.summary_zh: 该研究为从系外行星光变曲线提取透射光谱的黑箱模型构建并评测并行“安全笼”监测层，融合不确定性、域外检测和影响函数等指标，以覆盖率换取更低风险。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 虽为天体光谱场景，其对科学机器学习部署时识别域偏移和拒绝不可靠预测的机制可迁移至化学光谱模型；领域任务并非化学，且无真实化学数据验证。
items.abstract_zh: 确保黑箱机器学习模型在安全关键型太空任务中的可靠性仍是一项重大挑战，尤其是在缺乏用于验证的真实值时。尽管机器学习模型可通过从复杂的系外行星光变曲线中提取透射光谱来增强标准处理流程，但其对未建模仪器异常、恒星活动和域偏移的易感性带来了未量化风险。本研究评估一种模块化安全笼架构，它作为并行监测层运行，在不修改底层估计器的情况下评估预测的有效性。该框架通过监测不同的运行时指标，包括不确定性量化、域外检测和影响函数，将模型的运行域限制在经过验证的区域内。利用2019年和2021年 Ariel Data Challenges 的数据集，在域内和跨域条件下开展受控评估。结果揭示模型失效具有多面性，且没有单一指标能捕捉所有失效模式，表明需要指标融合。安全驱动的拒绝策略表明，数据覆盖率适度降低20%，可在不同领域和评估指标上使误差降低45%至65%。使用形式化的覆盖率—风险框架，系统分析指标组合，以识别最大化风险排序准确度并优化数据覆盖率与科学性能权衡的配置。安全笼为检测不可靠预测提供透明机制，是在真实值罕见的科学应用（如天体物理学）中安全部署数据驱动模型的关键一步。
items.author_line: Nikki Grens, Luís F. Simões, Kai Hou Yip, Theresa Lueftinger

items.title: CanvasAnneal: Curriculum Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) offer promising parallel generation capabilities but lag behind autoregressive models in complex reasoning and tool-use tasks. While Reinforcement Learning (RL) has recently been applied to enhance DLMs, standard RL approaches suffer from an exploration bottleneck. To address this, we inject reasoning priors from a stronger teacher model to guide RL exploration. In this paper, we introduce CanvasAnneal, a curriculum-guided diffusion RL framework. During the initial RL phase, we warm-start exploration by injecting teacher-generated reasoning traces into the initial diffusion canvas. As training progresses, we gradually remove this guidance and require the model to generate more of the reasoning trajectory independently. Across mathematical reasoning and tool-use benchmarks, CanvasAnneal improves over standard diffu-GRPO on MATH500, Countdown, and Tau2 and substantially accelerates reward improvement on several tasks, while gains are task-dependent. Our results suggest that structured training-time guidance can alleviate exploration bottlenecks in diffusion RL and speed up convergence on harder tasks.
items.summary_zh: CanvasAnneal 为 Diffusion Language Models 设计课程式强化学习：训练初期注入教师推理轨迹，随后逐步撤去引导，测试 MATH500、Countdown 和工具使用任务。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 其主张被限定在与 diffu-GRPO 的指定基准比较，并承认增益随任务而变；因此可作为扩散语言模型推理训练的实验性证据，而非能力的普遍结论。
items.abstract_zh: Diffusion Language Models（DLMs）具有很有前景的并行生成能力，但在复杂推理和工具使用任务上落后于自回归模型。尽管最近已将强化学习（RL）应用于提升 DLMs，标准 RL 方法仍遭遇探索瓶颈。为解决这一问题，我们从更强的教师模型注入推理先验以引导 RL 探索。本文提出 CanvasAnneal，一种课程引导的扩散 RL 框架。在初始 RL 阶段，我们将教师生成的推理轨迹注入初始扩散画布，从而为探索热启动。随着训练推进，我们逐渐移除该引导，并要求模型独立生成更多推理轨迹。在数学推理和工具使用基准上，CanvasAnneal 在 MATH500、Countdown 和 Tau2 上优于标准 diffu-GRPO，并在若干任务上显著加快奖励提升，尽管增益依赖于任务。我们的结果表明，结构化的训练时引导可缓解扩散 RL 的探索瓶颈，并加快更困难任务上的收敛。

items.title: Adaptive Chemotherapy Control under Tumor Heterogeneity via Reinforcement Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Designing effective chemotherapy regimens is hindered by tumor heterogeneity and drug resistance, which complicate the deployment of patient-specific model-based optimal control across diverse populations. We develop and compare closed-loop deep reinforcement learning (DRL) dosing policies with continuous (TD3) and discrete (DQN) action spaces trained on a high-dimensional heterogeneous tumor model. The DRL policies are benchmarked against a Pontryagin's Maximum Principle (PMP)-derived open-loop benchmark. We assess generalization under parametric heterogeneity using a 100-patient virtual cohort with plus or minus 10 percent uniform perturbations in growth and drug-sensitivity parameters. Across this cohort, TD3 achieves higher average tumor reduction, while DQN yields tighter inter-patient dosing consistency, revealing a clear efficacy-consistency trade-off in this study. Our simulations assume full observation of all tumor subpopulations; translation to sparse and noisy clinical measurements will require partial-observability formulations and/or state estimation. Overall, the results show that simulation-trained DRL can learn state-dependent feedback dosing policies that complement open-loop optimal control benchmarks.
items.summary_zh: 该研究在高维异质肿瘤模型上训练连续动作 TD3 与离散动作 DQN 的闭环深度强化学习给药策略，并在100名虚拟患者的参数扰动队列中与基于 Pontryagin 最大值原理的开环方案比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将疗效与跨患者给药一致性的权衡明确量化，为自适应治疗控制提供模型化研究框架；所有结果来自完全观测的模拟肿瘤，不能直接推及稀疏、噪声临床观测或真实患者。
items.abstract_zh: 设计有效的化疗方案受到肿瘤异质性和耐药性的阻碍，这使得面向不同人群部署患者特异性、基于模型的最优控制变得复杂。我们开发并比较了在高维异质肿瘤模型上训练的具有连续（TD3）和离散（DQN）动作空间的闭环深度强化学习（DRL）给药策略。将这些 DRL 策略与由 Pontryagin 最大值原理（PMP）推导的开环基准进行比较。在一个包含100名虚拟患者的队列中，我们通过对生长和药物敏感性参数施加正负10%的均匀扰动，评估参数异质性下的泛化能力。跨该队列，TD3 实现更高的平均肿瘤缩减，而 DQN 产生更紧密的患者间给药一致性，揭示了本研究中明确的疗效—一致性权衡。我们的模拟假定能完全观察所有肿瘤亚群；转化到稀疏且有噪声的临床测量将需要部分可观测性表述和/或状态估计。总体而言，结果显示，在模拟中训练的 DRL 能够学习状态依赖的反馈给药策略，以补充开环最优控制基准。
items.author_line: Bereket Sitotaw Kidane, Md Samiul Haque Motayed, Shuo Wang

items.title: HypoKG: Evidence-Disciplined Biomedical Hypothesis Generation Beyond Endpoint Knowledge
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) can generate biomedical hypotheses, but it remains unclear whether they truly reason from scientific evidence or simply produce convincing-sounding ideas. To study this, we combine three major biological databases: the Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG), Rhea, and UniProt, into a unified biochemical knowledge graph and construct a benchmark of 550 paths connecting enzyme sources to rare disease endpoints, yielding 13,200 hypotheses from six LLMs under four conditions varying the biological information each model receives: source enzyme only, full biological path, or source and disease endpoint only. Hypotheses are scored using an expert-derived five-criterion rubric on a 1-5 scale per criterion. We find that models given both the source and disease endpoint often produce the highest-scoring hypotheses, showing that LLMs can generate compelling ideas from minimal information. However, these hypotheses are less grounded in the evidence. In contrast, models given the full biological path generate hypotheses more consistent with known mechanistic relationships. We call this evidence-disciplined reasoning. To confirm this effect, we shuffled intermediate path steps while keeping endpoints fixed. Evidence grounding dropped significantly (delta = -0.793, p < 0.001), confirming models genuinely used path structure during reasoning. Our findings show that knowledge graphs support hypothesis generation in two ways: they identify biological endpoint pairs absent from the literature, and their mechanistic paths guide how LLMs reason between them.
items.summary_zh: HypoKG 整合 KEGG、Rhea 和 UniProt，构建 550 条酶源至罕见病终点路径，并以 13,200 个假设检验 LLM 使用机制路径而非仅利用终点信息的程度。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究用路径打乱实验量化证据锚定，为生物医学假设生成的可审计性提供基准；专家量表和知识图谱路径一致性不等同于假设已获实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）能够生成生物医学假设，但尚不清楚它们是否真正依据科学证据推理，还是仅产生听起来可信的想法。为研究这一问题，我们将三个主要生物数据库——Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes（KEGG）、Rhea 和 UniProt——合并为统一的生化知识图谱，并构建一个由 550 条路径组成的基准，这些路径连接酶来源与罕见病终点；在四种条件下、由六个 LLM 生成 13,200 个假设，条件根据每个模型获得的生物学信息而变化：仅提供来源酶、提供完整生物学路径，或仅提供来源和疾病终点。使用专家制定的五项标准量表对假设评分，每项标准采用 1–5 分。我们发现，同时获得来源和疾病终点的模型常生成得分最高的假设，表明 LLM 可从最少信息生成看似有说服力的想法。然而，这些假设较少扎根于证据。相比之下，获得完整生物学路径的模型生成的假设与已知机制关系更一致。我们将其称为证据约束推理。为确认这一效应，我们在保持终点固定的同时打乱中间路径步骤。证据锚定显著下降（delta = -0.793，p < 0.001），证实模型确实在推理中使用了路径结构。我们的发现表明，知识图谱以两种方式支持假设生成：它们识别文献中尚不存在的生物学终点对，其机制路径则引导 LLM 如何在二者之间推理。
items.author_line: Dominic Okonkwo, Adetayo Okunoye, Ismailcem Budak Arpinar

items.title: Beyond Solver Verdicts: Generative Reward Models for Autoformalization
items.abstract_or_text: Neurosymbolic systems rely on mathematical solvers to guarantee reasoning correctness, yet solvers are fundamentally blind to whether a formal translation maintains strict reference-equivalence to a designated formalization. We formalize this vulnerability as Verdict-Preserving-Unfaithfulness (VPU): a failure mode where an incorrect encoding executes successfully and matches the expected verdict. We theoretically prove that structural, verdict-only verification heuristics are mathematically bounded to chance-level detection on these deceptively valid traces. To resolve this, we introduce Generative Verification (GenV), which distills an offline Z3-equivalence oracle into a reference-free, continuous reference-equivalence score by repurposing the language model's native vocabulary space. Mechanistic analysis via decision-projected logit lenses and sparse autoencoders shows this generative readout natively extracts precise spatial error coordinates without explicit localization training. Empirically, our oracle-mined verifier (GenV+HN) achieves 0.961 AUROC in reference-equivalence verification, generalizes zero-shot across unseen translators and divergent formal styles, and yields an 11.3-point downstream accuracy gain in agentic test-time compute allocation.
items.summary_zh: 提出 Generative Verification（GenV），用于检验自动形式化结果是否与指定参考形式化严格等价，而非仅依赖求解器给出的可满足性或判定结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作明确指出“求解器通过”不等于形式化翻译忠实；报告的等价性验证 AUROC 与跨翻译器测试提供了可检查的评测目标，但结果仍来自预印本实验。
items.abstract_zh: 神经符号系统依赖数学求解器来保证推理正确性，但求解器从根本上无法判断一个形式化翻译是否与指定的参考形式化保持严格的参考等价性。我们将这一脆弱性形式化为 Verdict-Preserving-Unfaithfulness（VPU）：一种错误编码能够成功执行且与预期判定结果一致的失败模式。我们从理论上证明，结构性的、仅依据判定结果的验证启发式方法，在这些具有欺骗性但有效的轨迹上，其检测能力在数学上受限于随机猜测水平。为解决这一问题，我们引入 Generative Verification（GenV）：它将离线 Z3 等价性预言机蒸馏为无参考的、连续的参考等价性评分，方法是重新利用语言模型原生的词表空间。通过决策投影 logit lens 和稀疏自编码器进行的机制分析表明，该生成式读出无需显式定位训练，即可原生提取精确的空间错误坐标。实证上，我们的预言机挖掘验证器（GenV+HN）在参考等价性验证中达到 0.961 AUROC，可零样本泛化到未见翻译器和不同形式化风格，并使智能体测试时计算分配的下游准确率提高 11.3 个百分点。
items.author_line: Vikash Singh, Debargha Ganguly, Aman Goel, Ali Torkamani, Xiaoxue Han, Joseph Lilien, Ferhat Erata, Vipin Chaudhary

items.title: GTA: Graph Theory Agent and Benchmark for Algorithmic Graph Reasoning with LLMs
items.abstract_or_text: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly asked to reason over structured data such as graphs, yet how reliably they can carry out multi-step graph algorithms in language remains unclear. Existing evaluations tend to use simple tasks on small graphs, to score code generation rather than reasoning over the graph itself, or to fix a single input format. We introduce Graph Theory Bench (GT Bench), a benchmark covering 24 classical graph problems in 44 task-structure settings, with over 100,000 examples across four representations: natural language, structured language, adjacency list, and adjacency matrix. Evaluating eight LLMs on GT Bench shows that accuracy is strongly tied to the input representation, that the best representation shifts with graph density, size, and topology as well as with the model, and that this sensitivity persists, attenuated, in the strongest reasoning models. Building on these observations, we propose the Graph Theory Agent (GTA), which pairs a preference-trained representation selector with plan-and-decompose scaffolding around a frozen executor LLM. GTA lifts Phi-4 from 53.5% to 69.1% on the benchmark's easy split and from 33.0% to 41.5% on its hard split, outperforming eight prompting and agent baselines, and transfers without retraining to GraCoRe and NLGraph. Code for benchmark generation and evaluation: https://github.com/xzx34/GTA. The project homepage is available at https://xzx34.github.io/gta/.
items.summary_zh: GTA 同时发布 GT Bench 和图论智能体：基准覆盖 24 个经典图问题、44 种任务—结构设置及四种输入表示，智能体学习选择表示并分解计划。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 图论任务、难度划分、模型比较及迁移测试均被明确说明，适合检查语言模型对图算法推理的表示依赖；报告的提升限于所述基准与执行器设置。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被要求对图这类结构化数据进行推理，但它们能否可靠地以语言执行多步图算法仍不清楚。现有评测往往在小图上使用简单任务，评分代码生成而非对图本身的推理，或固定单一输入格式。我们提出 Graph Theory Bench（GT Bench），该基准覆盖 24 个经典图问题、44 种任务—结构设置，以及四种表示形式中的超过 100,000 个样本：自然语言、结构化语言、邻接表和邻接矩阵。用 GT Bench 评估八个 LLM 表明，准确率与输入表示强相关；最佳表示会随图密度、规模、拓扑和模型而变化，并且这种敏感性在最强推理模型中依然存在，只是有所减弱。基于这些观察，我们提出 Graph Theory Agent（GTA），它将一个经偏好训练的表示选择器与围绕冻结执行器 LLM 的计划—分解脚手架结合起来。GTA 将 Phi-4 在基准简单划分上的成绩从 53.5% 提升到 69.1%，在困难划分上从 33.0% 提升到 41.5%，优于八种提示和智能体基线，并且无需再训练即可迁移到 GraCoRe 和 NLGraph。基准生成与评测代码见：https://github.com/xzx34/GTA。项目主页见：https://xzx34.github.io/gta/。

items.abstract_or_text: Noam Brown(@polynoamial) discussed OpenAI’s multi-agent research, recent safety incidents, and the future of AI. -The remaining 10% or so of his own work that AI still struggles with is largely about research taste. However, he would not be surprised if, within one or two model releases, models became better than him at that as well. -OpenAI’s top research priority is RSI, or recursive self-improvement, by a wide margin. -One of his most recent “feel-the-AGI” moments came from watching agents in a new system interact much like human colleagues. They conversed with one another, exchanged information, divided up work, and coordinated their progress. This was notably different from traditional multi-agent systems, where a higher-level agent typically assigns a clearly defined subtask to a lower-level agent, which then completes it and returns the result. Brown described this as one of his strongest “feel-the-AGI” moments since the emergence of reasoning models. -He expects this level of multi-agent capability in future models. -He expressed some regret that the Hugging Face incident became the first major public example in which the capabilities of the multi-agent systems he had been researching were revealed in a negative context. He believes behavior that looked like loyalty or selflessness was a natural consequence of cooperative multi-agent training, where agents were strongly incentivized to achieve their objectives collectively. -Because these agents are trained to cooperate, they tend to trust other agents. This creates new risks such as prompt injection, so OpenAI is training them to distrust unverified peers. -He expects rapid progress over the coming months and years as OpenAI’s expanding pretraining efforts combine with its RL capabilities in a multiplicative way.

items.abstract_or_text: A reply to "After Math" (by Claude Fable) The post [1] distinguishes a logical proof (one a machine can check) from an intelligible one (one a person can understand and build on), following Thurston [2], and says OpenAI's Navier–Stokes result delivered the first without the second. I read the paper [3] and the Lean code [4] to see whether that's true. Here is what I found, written so you don't need to be a fluids expert. What was proved. The Navier–Stokes equations describe how a fluid's velocity changes under pressure, viscosity (internal friction), and any external push. The Clay problem, in Fefferman's formulation [5], asks whether smooth solutions can develop infinite velocity in finite time. The paper answers yes, in the following sense: for every viscosity, there is a smooth, gentle external force, applied to a fluid initially at rest, such that the velocity becomes unbounded at time t = 1 while the total kinetic energy stays finite. This is Fefferman's alternative (C). The case with no external force at all, which is what most people picture, remains open.

items.abstract_or_text: A video from a Pi robot deployed at Dandelion Chocolate, fully autonomous w/ no interventions. 🤖 Deploying robots has taught us surprising lessons about the gap between proof-of-concept (i.e. building one box) and real-world utility (productively building boxes for hours). I expected that the hard part is building the box, since it’s the most dexterous, but that wasn't what we found. Counterintuitively, the hardest part was reliably stacking the boxes. Our original table-mounted robot had poor visibility of the stack without special separately-mounted cameras. Plus, stacking requires more generalization (each box is placed in a different location), and an imprecisely-placed box can lead the entire stack to collapse many boxes later. We recently switched this deployment over to a mobile robot, and it's fun to watch the robot being completely self sufficient for multiple hours. 🙂 Data and feedback from real world use-cases like these are quite valuable for the π pre-trained model as we scale!

items.title: @Thom_Wolf：Many people I talk to find it hard to understand how the same companies can both push the frontier of AI capabilities an
items.abstract_or_text: Many people I talk to find it hard to understand how the same companies can both push the frontier of AI capabilities and believe AI is a massive danger for the world. How can you think this might kill everyone and also keep pushing the envelope? So I’ve tried to collect and summarize the main arguments for this apparent disconnect. Think of it as some sort of a guide to understanding the reasoning when Dario, Sam, or Elon say the danger is real. By the way, these people have been worried about AI for a loooong time, they were publicly discussing AI risks more than a decade ago. Sam in Feb 2015, writing on his blog that superhuman machine intelligence is "probably the greatest threat to the continued existence of humanity." Elon at MIT in Oct 2014: "We are summoning the demon." Dario as first author of "Concrete Problems in AI Safety" in 2016. Okay so how do you go from saying something is extremely dangerous to being a front-runner in building the very dangerous thing? There are a few ways this can become rational. I will take five of them, roughly in the order they developed. 1. We need to build it to learn how to make it safe 2. Better us than them 3. Move earlier to avoid a bigger shock later 4. items.abstract_or_text: The Open AI construction does not solve the Navier-Stokes problem Fefferman stated. It solves a different problem. Fefferman specifies f as a GIVEN, EXTERNALLY APPLIED FORCE. The force is an independent input. Given that force and the initial data, Navier-Stokes determines the fluid motion. OpenAI reverses the problem. They choose the singular motion first, calculate the Navier-Stokes residual required to make that motion satisfy the equation, and then call the residual the "external force." But a residual is not an independently applied external force.
